examples.en: The last firework turned out to be a dud.
examples.zh: 最后一个烟花结果是个哑炮。

meaning: n. 分歧;a. 发枝的, 分歧的

examples.en: Take the left path at the branching trail.
examples.zh: 到岔路口时走左边的小径。

meaning: 食物传播的, 食物传染的

examples.en: Proper chilling prevents most foodborne illness at home.
examples.zh: 正确冷藏可以在家中预防大多数食源性疾病。

meaning: n. 伏都教, 巫术, 巫术信仰

examples.en: Tourists watched a voodoo ritual in New Orleans.
examples.zh: 游客们在新奥尔良观看了一场伏都教仪式。

meaning: a. 丝带的, 花边的, 花边状的

examples.en: She wore a lacy shawl to the concert.
examples.zh: 她披着一条蕾丝披肩去听音乐会。

meaning: n. 纽伦堡

examples.en: Nuremberg hosts a famous Christmas market each December.
examples.zh: 纽伦堡每年十二月都举办著名的圣诞集市。

meaning: n. 法衣圣器储藏室, 祈祷室, 教区委员会;教堂法衣室

examples.en: The choir changed into robes in the vestry.
examples.zh: 唱诗班在法衣室里换上了法衣。

meaning: adv. 无空隙地; 无停顿地

examples.en: The app syncs seamlessly across all your devices.
examples.zh: 这款应用可以在你的所有设备间无缝同步。

meaning: n. 疝气;疝, 突出

examples.en: He needed minor surgery to repair a hernia.
examples.zh: 他需要做个小手术来修复疝气。

meaning: a. 植物的, 蔬菜的, 生长的, 无性繁殖的, 植物似的, 生活呆板单调的, 生长性的;植物性的; 生长的, 营养的

examples.en: The patient remained in a vegetative state for months.
examples.zh: 病人一连数月处于植物人状态。

meaning: n. 病原学, 病因学;病因学, 病原学

examples.en: Researchers are still unsure of the disease's etiology.
examples.zh: 研究人员仍然不确定这种疾病的病因。

meaning: n. 以赛亚(希伯来预言家), <<以赛亚书>>

examples.en: Isaiah urged the king to trust and wait.
examples.zh: 以赛亚劝国王要信靠并且耐心等候。

meaning: n. 一种大腊肠

examples.en: He packed a bologna sandwich for the trip.
examples.zh: 他为旅行带了一个博洛尼亚香肠三明治。

meaning: n. 蔬菜

examples.en: We grow fresh veg in our backyard.
examples.zh: 我们在自家后院种植新鲜蔬菜。

meaning: n. 爪哇, 爪哇咖啡

examples.en: I need a cup of java every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上都需要喝一杯咖啡。

meaning: n. 大都市, 集合城市

examples.en: Tokyo is the largest conurbation on earth.
examples.zh: 东京是全球最大的集合城市。

meaning: n. 换能器, 变换器;传感器; 翻译机; 变换器; 换能器

examples.en: The transducer converts sound waves into electrical signals.
examples.zh: 换能器把声波转换成电信号。

meaning: n. 斯大林主义者;a. 斯大林主义的；斯大林的

examples.en: The museum exhibits posters from the Stalinist period.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了斯大林时期的宣传海报。

meaning: n. 越野长跑训练

examples.en: Roadwork slowed the morning traffic considerably.
examples.zh: 道路施工让早高峰的车流明显变慢。

meaning: n. (1987年底爆发的)以色列占领区的巴勒斯坦人暴动

examples.en: The First Intifada began in Gaza in 1987.
examples.zh: 一九八七年,第一次因提法达在加沙爆发。

meaning: a. 斯拉夫的, 斯拉夫人的

examples.en: She studies Slavic languages at her university.
examples.zh: 她在大学里学习斯拉夫语言。

meaning: n. 块, 团

examples.en: Add a big dollop of cream on top.
examples.zh: 在上面加一大坨奶油。

meaning: n. 布商, 绸缎商人, 呢绒布商

examples.en: The mercer sold fine silk to the tailor.
examples.zh: 绸缎商把上好的丝绸卖给了裁缝。

meaning: vi. 鬼鬼祟祟地走, (动物)早产;vt. 早产

examples.en: The cat was slinking along the garden wall.
examples.zh: 那只猫沿着花园围墙悄悄溜行。

meaning: n. 人种志学者, 人种学者

examples.en: The ethnographer recorded folk songs in the village.
examples.zh: 那位人种学者在村子里录制民歌。

meaning: n. 女警察;女警察

examples.en: A policewoman directed traffic after the accident.
examples.zh: 一名女交警在事故后指挥交通。

meaning: n. 调音, 调谐, 协调;调整

examples.en: The piano needs tuning before the concert.
examples.zh: 音乐会之前,这架钢琴需要调音。

meaning: 刘易斯(东苏塞克斯郡首府)

examples.en: Lewes is famous for its bonfire night parades.
examples.zh: 刘易斯以篝火之夜的游行而闻名。

meaning: vt. 强迫, 用推土机推平/削平, 用推土机清除, 压倒, 威胁

examples.en: They plan to bulldoze the old warehouse.
examples.zh: 他们计划用推土机推平那座旧仓库。

meaning: n. 桶, 木桶;vt. 装入桶内

examples.en: The wine ages slowly in an oak cask.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒在橡木桶里慢慢陈酿。

meaning: n. 侦察活动, 童子军活动;初步勘探

examples.en: Scouting teaches young people practical outdoor skills.
examples.zh: 童子军活动教给青少年实用的户外技能。

meaning: n. 丁香, 丁香花, 淡紫色;a. 淡紫色的

examples.en: The lilac bushes bloom every May.
examples.zh: 丁香花丛每年五月都会开花。

meaning: n. 乔叟（英国作家）

examples.en: Chaucer wrote his famous tales over six centuries ago.
examples.zh: 六百多年前,乔叟写下了他著名的故事集。

meaning: n. 新闻纸;新闻纸

examples.en: The parcel was wrapped in old newsprint.
examples.zh: 包裹是用旧报纸包起来的。

meaning: n. 小猪;a. 贪心的, 似猪的, 邋遢的

examples.en: The little piggy rolled in the cool mud.
examples.zh: 小猪在凉凉的泥浆里打滚。

meaning: n. 耶西(<<圣径>>故事人物)

examples.en: Jesse borrowed our notes before the history exam.
examples.zh: 杰西在历史考试前借走了我们的笔记。

meaning: n. 安布罗斯(m.)

examples.en: Ambrose drove us to the airport at dawn.
examples.zh: 安布罗斯黎明时分开车送我们去机场。

meaning: n. 燕雀, 歌鸟, 女歌手

examples.en: The robin is a familiar songbird in gardens.
examples.zh: 知更鸟是花园里常见的鸣禽。

meaning: n. 食品与炊具洗涤处, 食品与炊具存放室

examples.en: Gran kept her copper pots in the scullery.
examples.zh: 奶奶把铜锅存放在洗涤室里。

meaning: n. 图案结构, 特有型式, 图形

examples.en: The ancient pottery shows bold geometric patterning.
examples.zh: 古代陶器上绘有醒目的几何纹样。

meaning: n. 扎伊尔;流行性霍乱

examples.en: Zaire was later renamed the Democratic Republic of Congo.
examples.zh: 扎伊尔后来改名为刚果民主共和国。

meaning: n. 硬式棒球（等于baseball）；（为达到某种目的而采取的）强硬手段；刀剑搏杀

examples.en: The firm played hardball during the wage talks.
examples.zh: 这家公司在工资谈判中采取了强硬手段。

meaning: adv. 鄙视地, 轻蔑地

examples.en: She glanced scornfully at his worn-out shoes.
examples.zh: 她轻蔑地瞥了一眼他那双破旧的鞋。

meaning: n. 笨蛋, 蠢材

examples.en: He felt like a real boob after forgetting her name.
examples.zh: 他忘了她的名字,感觉自己真是个笨蛋。

meaning: n. 体育专栏作家

examples.en: The sportswriter predicted the home team would win the final.
examples.zh: 那位体育专栏作家预测主队会赢得决赛。

meaning: a. 辩证的, 辩证法的

examples.en: The professor explained dialectical reasoning in our philosophy class.
examples.zh: 教授在哲学课上讲解了辩证推理。

meaning: n. 骚扰, 大批出没, 横行;侵染, 感染

examples.en: The farmer called an expert about the rat infestation.
examples.zh: 农场主请专家来处理鼠患。

meaning: n. 明尼苏达州

examples.en: She moved to Minnesota last winter for a new job.
examples.zh: 她去年冬天为了新工作搬到了明尼苏达州。

meaning: n. 分开, 空闲, 解脱;解脱(分娩)

examples.en: The general announced the disengagement of troops from the border.
examples.zh: 将军宣布部队撤离边境。

meaning: n. 蛋黄酱（等于mayonnaise）

examples.en: I always add extra mayo to my turkey sandwich.
examples.zh: 我的火鸡三明治总要多加蛋黄酱。

meaning: v. 反映( mirror的过去式和过去分词 ); 反射; 映照; 将（玻璃）喷镀成镜子

examples.en: The sales figures mirrored the growing demand online.
examples.zh: 销售数据反映了线上不断增长的需求。

meaning: n. 小孩

examples.en: The grandmother smiled at the bairn playing by the door.
examples.zh: 奶奶对着在门口玩耍的小孩微笑。

meaning: n. 高射炮

examples.en: The soldiers ducked as archibald burst above the trench.
examples.zh: 高射炮在战壕上空炸响,士兵们赶紧低头。

meaning: a. 大陆间的, 洲际的

examples.en: They booked an intercontinental flight from London to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 他们订了从伦敦到东京的洲际航班。

meaning: n. 基尼(英国昔金币单位), 运煤帆船

examples.en: The old geordie carried coal along the coast in 1850.
examples.zh: 旧运煤帆船在1850年沿海岸运煤。

meaning: n. 测向, 偏航显示;测知

examples.en: Remote sensing helps scientists track changes in the forest.
examples.zh: 遥感技术帮助科学家追踪森林变化。

meaning: n. 项, 颈背;项, 颈背

examples.en: The barber trimmed the hair at the nape of his neck.
examples.zh: 理发师修剪了他后颈的头发。

meaning: a. 使干枯的, 使萎缩的

examples.en: The young crops could not survive the withering heat.
examples.zh: 幼苗熬不过那灼人的酷热。

meaning: a. 宝贵的, 珍贵的;v. 重视( treasure的过去式和过去分词 ); 珍惜; 珍视; 珍爱

examples.en: She kept her grandmother's ring as a treasured memory.
examples.zh: 她把祖母的戒指当作珍贵的纪念。

meaning: n. 堪培拉

examples.en: They visited Canberra to see the national gallery.
examples.zh: 他们去堪培拉参观国家美术馆。

meaning: n. 命名法, 专门语, 术语;命名法; 命名原则

examples.en: The biology exam tested our knowledge of plant nomenclature.
examples.zh: 生物考试考了植物命名法的知识。

meaning: a. 崇拜的, 敬慕的

examples.en: The singer waved to his adoring fans after the show.
examples.zh: 演出结束后,歌手向狂热的歌迷挥手。

meaning: n. 酒吧女侍, 酒吧女招待

examples.en: The barmaid greeted the regulars with a friendly smile.
examples.zh: 酒吧女侍微笑着招呼熟客。

meaning: n. 赫胥黎, 生物学家

examples.en: Our class discussed Huxley's vision of the future.
examples.zh: 我们课上讨论了赫胥黎对未来的构想。

meaning: n. 微米;微米

examples.en: This filter traps particles smaller than one micron.
examples.zh: 这种滤网能拦住小于一微米的颗粒。

meaning: 布鲁日

examples.en: They spent a weekend in Bruges exploring the old canals.
examples.zh: 他们在布鲁日玩了一个周末,游览古老的运河。

meaning: a. 多岩的, 崎岖的, 峻峭的, 多峭壁的

examples.en: The hikers admired the craggy peaks of the highlands.
examples.zh: 徒步者赞叹高地的峭壁群峰。

meaning: n. 安格尔西岛（英国威尔士西北部一岛）

examples.en: Their cottage on Anglesey overlooks a quiet bay.
examples.zh: 他们安格尔西岛的小屋俯瞰安静的海湾。

meaning: n. 极权主义;极权主义

examples.en: The course examines the rise of totalitarianism in Europe.
examples.zh: 这门课研究极权主义在欧洲的兴起。

meaning: (色彩、音调、措词、意味、香韵、感情等)有细微差别的

examples.en: Her nuanced answers impressed the interview panel.
examples.zh: 她细腻的回答让面试小组印象深刻。

meaning: a. 花开着的, 用花装饰的

examples.en: She wore a bright flowered dress to the garden party.
examples.zh: 她穿着一条鲜艳的印花裙去参加花园派对。

meaning: n. 便帽（苏格兰人戴的）

examples.en: The old man pulled his wool tam lower against the wind.
examples.zh: 老人把羊毛便帽往下拉了拉挡风。

meaning: n. 剁碎的食物, 杂乱无章的的一大堆, 杂烩, 复述;vt. 切碎, 搞糟

examples.en: We ordered corned beef hash and coffee at the diner.
examples.zh: 我们在小餐馆点了腌牛肉杂烩和咖啡。

meaning: 巴尔弗

examples.en: The seminar discussed the Balfour declaration of 1917.
examples.zh: 研讨课讨论了1917年的鲍尔弗宣言。

meaning: n. 去壳, 谷壳, 贝壳的采集, 炮轰

examples.en: The old city survived heavy shelling during the war.
examples.zh: 这座老城在战争中经受住了猛烈炮击。

meaning: n. 巡回, 巡回法院;巡回, 巡回法庭

examples.en: The justices rode on eyre to hear cases in the north.
examples.zh: 法官们巡回北上审理案件。

meaning: n. 搜索者, 调查官, 检查官;搜查者, 检查者, 搜寻者

examples.en: The searcher swept the beach with a metal detector.
examples.zh: 探寻者用金属探测器扫过沙滩。

meaning: n. 护墙板, 护壁板, 桶板;vt. 给...覆盖护墙板

examples.en: They painted the clapboard siding of the cottage white.
examples.zh: 他们把小屋的护墙板漆成了白色。

meaning: 拉特兰郡

examples.en: Rutland is known as England's smallest county.
examples.zh: 拉特兰是英格兰最小的郡。

meaning: n. 印象主义者, 印象派作家

examples.en: The gallery shows several works by French impressionist painters.
examples.zh: 美术馆展出了几幅法国印象派画家的作品。

meaning: n. 鳕鱼, 帚石南

examples.en: The hills turn purple when the ling blooms in August.
examples.zh: 八月石楠开花时,山丘变成紫色。

meaning: n. 德国兵, 德国人

examples.en: The office printer is on the fritz again this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上办公室的打印机又出毛病了。

meaning: n. 银莲花, 海葵;银莲花属(毛莨科)

examples.en: Bright anemone flowers lined the garden path in spring.
examples.zh: 春天,鲜艳的银莲花沿着花园小径开放。

meaning: n. 红隼

examples.en: A kestrel hovered over the field, watching for mice.
examples.zh: 一只红隼悬停在田野上空搜寻老鼠。

meaning: a. 吱吱响的, 发轧声的

examples.en: The squeaky door hinge needs a few drops of oil.
examples.zh: 吱吱响的门铰链需要滴几滴油。

meaning: n. 爱默生（Ralph Waldo Emerson 美国思想家, 诗人）

examples.en: Our teacher quoted Emerson on the value of self-reliance.
examples.zh: 老师引用爱默生关于自立的名言。

meaning: 发汗;出汗

examples.en: He was sweating heavily after climbing the office stairs.
examples.zh: 爬完办公室的楼梯后,他满头大汗。

meaning: 特殊性

examples.en: The festival celebrates the distinctiveness of the island culture.
examples.zh: 这个节日颂扬海岛文化的独特性。

meaning: n. 晶石, 圆材, 拳斗, 争论;vt. 装圆材于

examples.en: The boxers spar lightly to warm up before a fight.
examples.zh: 拳击手赛前轻轻对练热身。

meaning: hang的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: She hung the family photos along the hallway wall.
examples.zh: 她把全家福挂在走廊墙上。

meaning: n. 天真烂漫, 无邪, 纯真

examples.en: His naivete about contracts cost him a lot of money.
examples.zh: 他对合同的天真让他损失了一大笔钱。

meaning: 分离的, 分隔的

examples.en: Volunteers are separating the recyclables from the general trash.
examples.zh: 志愿者正在把可回收物和普通垃圾分开。

meaning: a. 纤维的, 纤维性的;纤维性

examples.en: Old celery turns tough and fibrous, so buy fresh stalks.
examples.zh: 芹菜放久了又老又筋,要买新鲜的。

meaning: (=lasagne)烤宽面条(上浇肉末番茄汁)

examples.en: Mom baked a huge lasagna for the family dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 妈妈为今晚的家庭晚餐烤了一大盆千层面。

meaning: n. 反攻, 反击;v. 反攻, 反击

examples.en: The army launched a counterattack at first light.
examples.zh: 军队在拂晓时分发起反击。

meaning: a. 作为说明的, 解释的

examples.en: The guide gave an interpretative talk about the cave paintings.
examples.zh: 讲解员对洞穴壁画进行了讲解。

meaning: a. 停息的, 盛开过的, 浮夸的;overblow的过去分词

examples.en: Many viewers felt the media coverage of the storm was overblown.
examples.zh: 许多观众觉得媒体对这场风暴的报道太夸张。

meaning: PASCAL语言;帕斯卡

examples.en: In physics class we measured pressure in pascal units.
examples.zh: 物理课上我们用帕斯卡为单位测压强。

meaning: 格温特郡

examples.en: The old road into Gwent follows the river for miles.
examples.zh: 通往格温特的旧路沿河绵延数英里。

meaning: n. 门廊

examples.en: Guests waited under the portico for the rain to stop.
examples.zh: 客人们待在门廊下等雨停。

meaning: a. 产后的;产后的

examples.en: She joined a postpartum yoga class with other new mothers.
examples.zh: 她和其他新妈妈一起上产后瑜伽课。

meaning: n. 侯爵, 侯爵长子的尊称

examples.en: The marquess opened his castle gardens to visitors each June.
examples.zh: 侯爵每年六月向游客开放他的城堡花园。

meaning: v. (使)重新定居

examples.en: Many families resettle in safer towns after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水过后,许多家庭搬到更安全的城镇。

meaning: n. 蒸馏室, 酿酒厂, 酒厂;酒厂; 造酒厂

examples.en: The island distillery offers guided tours every summer morning.
examples.zh: 这家岛上的酿酒厂夏季每天上午提供导览。

meaning: n. 飞机场, 机场

examples.en: The wartime aerodrome is now a small aviation museum.
examples.zh: 那座战时机场如今是一座小型航空博物馆。

meaning: n. 重量, 影响, 重要性;vt. 举起试重量, 举起

examples.en: She hefted the suitcase to see if it was too heavy.
examples.zh: 她掂了掂行李箱,看是不是太重了。

meaning: Council 惠特利协议会(即英国联合工业协议会)

examples.en: The Whitley Council once set pay scales for public workers.
examples.zh: 惠特利协议会曾为公务人员制定工资标准。

meaning: a. 好的, 第一流的, 大的

examples.en: I locked my keys in the car again, what a wally!
examples.zh: 我又把钥匙锁在车里了,真是个笨蛋!

meaning: n. 中庭, 庭院

examples.en: Monks once grew healing herbs in the cathedral garth.
examples.zh: 修道士们曾在大教堂的庭院里种草药。

meaning: n. 活动的东西, 动产;a. 可动的, 可移动的, 不定的

examples.en: Movable walls let the family reshape the loft as needed.
examples.zh: 活动隔墙让这家人可以按需要改造阁楼。

meaning: 量化, 定量;定量比率

examples.en: Precise quantification of the damage took the team weeks.
examples.zh: 精确量化损失让团队花了好几周。

meaning: n. (基督教的)教理问答, 一套问答

examples.en: The children recited questions from the catechism every Sunday.
examples.zh: 孩子们每个星期天背诵教义问答。

meaning: 残废, 无能

examples.en: The policy pays out for permanent disablement caused at work.
examples.zh: 这份保单对工作造成的永久残疾进行赔付。

meaning: 流挂

examples.en: The sagging shelves bent under the weight of the dictionaries.
examples.zh: 下垂的架子被词典的重量压弯了。

meaning: n. 世界末日, 最后审判日

examples.en: The Domesday Book recorded landholdings across England in 1086.
examples.zh: 《末日审判书》记录了1086年英格兰的土地。

meaning: n. 小田地, 小农场

examples.en: The family has worked the same croft for four generations.
examples.zh: 这家人在同一块小田地上耕作了四代。

meaning: n. 无头甘蓝类, 甘蓝菜, 蔬菜;羽衣甘蓝

examples.en: She adds fresh kale and banana to her morning smoothie.
examples.zh: 她在早晨的果昔里加新鲜羽衣甘蓝和香蕉。

meaning: a. 流浪的, 移居的, 漫游的, 外国的, 异样的, 异国风味的, 外来的;n. 寄居外国的人

examples.en: Pigeons scattered when the peregrine dove from the tower.
examples.zh: 游隼从塔上俯冲下来,鸽子四散而逃。

meaning: n. 乍得;孔屑

examples.en: He spent two years teaching English in Chad.
examples.zh: 他在乍得教了两年英语。

meaning: a. 瘦的, 骨瘦如柴的

examples.en: That scrawny stray cat needs a good home and regular meals.
examples.zh: 那只瘦弱的流浪猫需要一个家和规律的饮食。

meaning: n. 苏门答腊岛（印尼西部的大岛）

examples.en: Their coffee beans come from small farms in Sumatra.
examples.zh: 他们的咖啡豆来自苏门答腊的小农场。

meaning: n. 巴布亚岛

examples.en: The island of Papua is home to many rare birds.
examples.zh: 巴布亚岛是许多珍稀鸟类的家园。

meaning: n. 格构, 格子结构, 棚, 架, 棚架式拱道, 格子遮板, 格构遮板, 格构凉亭, 格构拱道;vt. 为...建棚架

examples.en: Sweet peas climbed the wooden trellis beside the patio.
examples.zh: 香豌豆爬上了院子旁的木棚架。

meaning: abbr. 宾夕法尼亚大学（Pennsylvania）

examples.en: She is starting a nursing degree at Penn this fall.
examples.zh: 她今年秋天要在宾大开始读护理学位。

meaning: adv. 在修辞学上, 讲究修辞地

examples.en: She asked rhetorically whether anyone could ignore the problem.
examples.zh: 她反问道,谁能对这个问题视而不见。

meaning: n. 拿铁咖啡; （意大利语）牛奶

examples.en: He grabs a large latte before work every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上上班前都要买一大杯拿铁。

meaning: n. Frances 的爱称；屁股；女子救护队队员

examples.en: He slipped on the ice and landed on his fanny.
examples.zh: 他滑了一跤,一屁股坐在冰上。

meaning: adv. 古典主义地, 拟古地

examples.en: She is a classically trained pianist who loves jazz.
examples.zh: 她是科班出身的钢琴家,却热爱爵士乐。

meaning: n. 密谋者, 策划者, 绘图员, 绘图仪;绘图仪

examples.en: The chronicles describe him as the chief plotter of the rebellion.
examples.zh: 编年史称他是叛乱的主谋。

meaning: n. 雄火鸡

examples.en: A proud gobbler strutted across the farmyard at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时,一只神气的雄火鸡在农家院里大摇大摆。

meaning: n. 地主, 领主;地主

examples.en: The laird invited the whole village to the harvest supper.
examples.zh: 地主邀请全村人来吃丰收晚餐。

meaning: n. 光毛呢

examples.en: The tailor lined the winter coat with soft saxony wool.
examples.zh: 裁缝用柔软的萨克森呢给冬大衣加了衬里。

meaning: n. 丹妮尔(f.)

examples.en: Danielle offered to drive us to the airport on Saturday.
examples.zh: 丹妮尔主动提出周六开车送我们去机场。

meaning: n. 唤出, 招魂, 唤起;启发作用(唤起形态形成的潜势力)

examples.en: The novel is a warm evocation of village life in the fifties.
examples.zh: 这部小说温情地再现了五十年代的乡村生活。

meaning: n. 犹他

examples.en: They hiked through the red rock canyons of southern Utah.
examples.zh: 他们在犹他州南部的红岩峡谷中徒步。

meaning: n. 耶和华

examples.en: The congregation sang hymns of praise to Jehovah.
examples.zh: 会众唱起赞美耶和华的圣歌。

meaning: n. 宣誓书

examples.en: Old sailors joked about Davy Jones's locker keeping lost ships.
examples.zh: 老水手常开玩笑说沉船都进了戴维·琼斯的柜子。

meaning: a. 两代人之间的

examples.en: The center runs intergenerational cooking classes for teens and seniors.
examples.zh: 中心为青少年和老人开设代际烹饪课。

meaning: 边缘化

examples.en: The report examines the marginalization of rural communities.
examples.zh: 报告考察了农村社区被边缘化的问题。

meaning: n. 纳粹党所用的十字记号

examples.en: The museum traces the long history of the swastika symbol.
examples.zh: 博物馆追溯了万字符号的悠久历史。

meaning: n. 劳顿（美国城镇）

examples.en: She grew up in Lawton before moving to Dallas for college.
examples.zh: 她在劳顿长大,后来去达拉斯上大学。

meaning: n. 个人主义者, 利己主义者

examples.en: As a stubborn individualist, he refused to join any team.
examples.zh: 他是个固执的个人主义者,拒绝加入任何团队。

meaning: v. 梭编, 梭织;n. 衣衫褴褛(的人), 粗麻布, 轻击

examples.en: The gift shop was full of cheap tat aimed at tourists.
examples.zh: 纪念品店里满是糊弄游客的廉价破烂。

meaning: n. 资本化, 资本总额, 本金化, 大写;(收益的)资本化, 资本总额

examples.en: Check the capitalization of the names before printing the poster.
examples.zh: 打印海报前检查一下名字的大写。

meaning: a. 紧迫的, 繁忙的

examples.en: She pressed the button and waited for the elevator.
examples.zh: 她按下按钮等电梯来。

meaning: a. 有关连的；附属的

examples.en: The children's hospital is affiliated with the state university.
examples.zh: 这家儿童医院隶属于州立大学。

meaning: n. 轨道飞行器, 人造卫星

examples.en: The orbiter sent back sharp images of the Martian surface.
examples.zh: 轨道飞行器传回了火星表面的清晰图像。

meaning: a. 极度紧张不安的

examples.en: Too much coffee makes me jittery before exams.
examples.zh: 考试前喝太多咖啡会让我紧张发慌。

meaning: n. 书包, 小背包

examples.en: The boy slung his leather satchel over one shoulder.
examples.zh: 男孩把皮书包挎在一边肩膀上。

meaning: a. 成长受妨碍的, 发育不良的;发育障碍的, 短小的

examples.en: Lack of sunlight left the seedlings stunted and pale.
examples.zh: 缺少阳光使幼苗长得矮小发黄。

meaning: n. 仓鼠;仓鼠

examples.en: The hamster runs on its wheel all night long.
examples.zh: 仓鼠整夜在轮子上跑个不停。

meaning: n. 组成者, 构成者, 筹划者;调帧器

examples.en: The framers of the constitution met in Philadelphia in 1787.
examples.zh: 宪法制定者们1787年在费城开会。

meaning: n. 被截肢者;切肢者

examples.en: The clinic helps each amputee adjust to a prosthetic leg.
examples.zh: 诊所帮助每位截肢者适应假腿。

meaning: adv. 在背面, 在次页

examples.en: Please complete the form overleaf and sign at the bottom.
examples.zh: 请填写下一页的表格并在末尾签名。

meaning: n. 床单, 床罩

examples.en: She chose a quilted bedspread for the guest room.
examples.zh: 她为客房挑了一床绗缝床罩。

meaning: n. 自由化；开放

examples.en: The minister praised the liberalisation of the airline market.
examples.zh: 部长称赞航空市场的自由化。

meaning: n. 传动装置;比例结合, 齿轮作用

examples.en: The mechanic replaced the worn gearing inside the old truck.
examples.zh: 机修工更换了旧卡车里磨损的传动装置。

meaning: n. 爆裂, 喷出;井喷

examples.en: We had a blowout on the highway and missed the meeting.
examples.zh: 我们在高速上爆了胎,还错过了会议。

meaning: a. 王朝的

examples.en: The palace displays treasures from the dynastic period of China.
examples.zh: 这座宫殿展出中国王朝时期的珍宝。

meaning: n. 晒衣绳

examples.en: Grandma pinned the wet sheets to the clothesline.
examples.zh: 奶奶把湿床单夹在晾衣绳上。

meaning: n. 摩纳哥

examples.en: They watched the Grand Prix in Monaco last May.
examples.zh: 他们去年五月在摩纳哥看了大奖赛。

meaning: a. 让步的, 特许的;n. 特许权获得者

examples.en: Students and seniors can buy tickets at concessionary prices.
examples.zh: 学生和老人可以按优惠价购票。

meaning: n. 懦弱

examples.en: He regretted the cowardice that kept him silent in the meeting.
examples.zh: 他后悔开会时因怯懦而一言不发。

meaning: n. 甲安菲他明（一种兴奋剂）

examples.en: The film shows how meth addiction destroyed a young life.
examples.zh: 影片展示了冰毒如何毁掉一个年轻的生命。

meaning: abbr. 英国皇家航空研究中心（Royal Aeronautical Establishment）；研究评估考核（高等教育基金会为研究项目拨款所使用的考评工具

examples.en: Rae promised to call as soon as her flight landed.
examples.zh: 雷答应一下飞机就打电话。

meaning: n. 匹兹堡

examples.en: My cousin is studying engineering at a college in Pittsburgh.
examples.zh: 我表哥在匹兹堡的一所大学学工程。

meaning: n. 奇妙, 不可思议, 陌生;奇异性

examples.en: There was a quiet strangeness about the empty streets that night.
examples.zh: 那晚空荡荡的街道有种说不出的怪异。

meaning: n. 横幅, 饰带, 流光, 通栏标题

examples.en: Colorful streamers hung from the ceiling all over the party room.
examples.zh: 派对的天花板上挂满了彩色纸带。

meaning: n. 圣地亚哥

examples.en: They flew to Santiago to spend Christmas with her family.
examples.zh: 他们飞往圣地亚哥和家人过圣诞节。

meaning: a. 跳跃的, 巨大的, 活泼的;由于资金不足而拒付支票

examples.en: The couple welcomed a bouncing baby girl last week.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇上周喜迎一个健康的女儿。

meaning: L形吊骨

examples.en: The crowd roared as Jagger strutted across the stage.
examples.zh: 贾格尔神气地走过舞台时,人群欢呼起来。

meaning: n. 托尔斯泰（俄国小说家）

examples.en: Our book club is reading a short story by Tolstoy.
examples.zh: 我们的读书会正在读托尔斯泰的短篇小说。

meaning: adv. 率直地, 坦白地

examples.en: She spoke candidly about her early failures as a manager.
examples.zh: 她坦率地谈起自己早年当经理时的失败。

meaning: n. 唯物主义者

examples.en: As a strict materialist, he believes only in measurable evidence.
examples.zh: 作为严格的唯物主义者,他只相信可测量的证据。

meaning: n. 不正当的举止, 不规矩的行为;行为不端, 品行不良, 不正当的举止

examples.en: The school called home about the student's repeated misbehavior.
examples.zh: 学校因该生屡次违纪而打电话给家长。

meaning: n. 震中, 中心

examples.en: The epicenter of the earthquake lay fifty miles offshore.
examples.zh: 这次地震的震中在近海五十英里处。

meaning: n. 外国话, 隐语;行话, 航业暗语

examples.en: It took a month to learn the lingo in the newsroom.
examples.zh: 我花了一个月才学会编辑部的行话。

meaning: 解除管制

examples.en: The government plans to deregulate the bus industry next year.
examples.zh: 政府计划明年放开对巴士行业的管制。

meaning: v. 任命（某人）为牧师( ordain的过去式和过去分词 ); 授予（某人）圣职; （上帝、法律等）命令; 判定

examples.en: He was ordained as a priest at the age of thirty.
examples.zh: 他三十岁时被任命为牧师。

meaning: n. 泥浆；悬浮液

examples.en: Farmers spread slurry on the fields as fertilizer every spring.
examples.zh: 农民每年春天把泥浆肥料施进田里。

meaning: a. 圣方济修会的;n. 圣方济会的修道士

examples.en: A Franciscan in a brown robe welcomed us at the gate.
examples.zh: 一位穿棕色长袍的方济各会修士在门口迎接我们。

meaning: n. （希腊和中东地区的）皮塔饼

examples.en: She filled the warm pita with grilled vegetables and hummus.
examples.zh: 她把烤蔬菜和鹰嘴豆泥塞进热皮塔饼里。

meaning: n. 缰绳, 笼头;绞刑, 绞索

examples.en: She led the pony by its halter to the stable.
examples.zh: 她牵着缰绳把小马带回马厩。

meaning: n. 脑膜炎;脑膜炎

examples.en: A student was hospitalized with meningitis during the spring term.
examples.zh: 春季学期有一名学生因脑膜炎住院。

meaning: n. 小溪；目的地；边界

examples.en: A quiet bourne runs along the northern edge of the meadow.
examples.zh: 一条安静的小溪流过草地的北缘。

meaning: n. 合宪法性;符合宪法, 合宪性, 立宪

examples.en: The court must rule on the constitutionality of the new law.
examples.zh: 法院必须裁定新法律的合宪性。

meaning: n. 布伦海姆（德国西部村庄）；布伦海姆（狗的一种）；布伦海姆（轰炸机）

examples.en: They toured the great palace at Blenheim on a sunny afternoon.
examples.zh: 晴朗的午后,他们游览了布伦海姆宫。

meaning: 采集管理信息系统, 先进管理信息系统, 自动化管理信息系统

examples.en: This term we are studying a comic novel by Amis.
examples.zh: 这学期我们在读艾米斯的一部喜剧小说。

meaning: n. 学校作业, 家庭作业

examples.en: He finishes his schoolwork before playing any video games.
examples.zh: 他先完成功课再玩电子游戏。

meaning: a. 微小的, 不足道的;n. 便壶

examples.en: The toddler proudly used the potty all by herself.
examples.zh: 小女孩骄傲地自己坐便盆上厕所。

meaning: n. 蒸馏者, 蒸馏器, 制酒者;蒸馏器

examples.en: The master distiller tasted the whisky straight from the cask.
examples.zh: 首席酿酒师直接从木桶里品尝威士忌。

meaning: v. 压扁；折叠；崩溃；塌陷（collapse的ing形式）

examples.en: Firefighters rushed everyone out of the collapsing building.
examples.zh: 消防员把所有人撤出正在倒塌的大楼。

meaning: heave的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The sailors hove the heavy anchor up at sunrise.
examples.zh: 水手们在日出时把沉重的锚绞了上来。

meaning: n. Y字形物;Y形接头

examples.en: The plumber installed a wye to split the water pipe.
examples.zh: 水管工装了一个Y形接头来分流管道。

meaning: n. 蒙古

examples.en: They rode horses across the open steppe in Mongolia.
examples.zh: 他们在蒙古骑马穿越辽阔的草原。

meaning: a. 租赁的;n. 租赁权, 租赁

examples.en: They bought the riverside flat on a long leasehold.
examples.zh: 他们以长期租赁权买下了河畔公寓。

meaning: n. 小舰队, 小型船队

examples.en: A flotilla of small boats escorted the royal barge upstream.
examples.zh: 一小队船只护送皇家游艇逆流而上。

meaning: vt. 再取, 取回, 重摄;n. 重拍, 取回

examples.en: She plans to retake the driving test next month.
examples.zh: 她打算下个月重新参加驾照考试。

meaning: n. 泥盖木屋

examples.en: The family slept in a traditional hogan on the reservation.
examples.zh: 这家人在保留区传统的泥盖木屋里过夜。

meaning: vt. 展开, 张开, 使成八字形;vi. 伸展开

examples.en: The stool's legs splay outward to keep it steady.
examples.zh: 凳子腿向外张开以保持稳固。

meaning: n. 委员, 市议会议员;议会议员, 市议员

examples.en: The councilman promised to fix the broken streetlights on our road.
examples.zh: 市议员承诺修理我们这条路坏了的路灯。

meaning: n. 字面, 字体, 印出的文字(或图样);字体, 字样

examples.en: Choose a clear typeface for the presentation slides.
examples.zh: 给演示幻灯片选一种清晰的字体。

meaning: a. 标准以下的, 不合规格的;低于定额的

examples.en: Inspectors closed the restaurant for substandard kitchen hygiene.
examples.zh: 检查员因后厨卫生不达标查封了这家餐厅。

meaning: a. 可恶的, 该死的;闪烁

examples.en: A blinking red light warned drivers about ice ahead.
examples.zh: 闪烁的红灯提醒司机前方路面结冰。

meaning: a. 鬼祟的, 卑微的

examples.en: My sneaky brother hides the best cookies behind the flour.
examples.zh: 狡猾的弟弟把最好的饼干藏在面粉后面。

meaning: n. 都灵（意大利城市）

examples.en: They admired the historic arcades of Turin on foot.
examples.zh: 他们步行游览了都灵的历史拱廊街。

meaning: n. 哈德良（罗马皇帝）

examples.en: Hadrian ordered a wall built across northern Britain.
examples.zh: 哈德良下令在不列颠北部修建城墙。

meaning: n. 调情, 挑逗, 调戏, 不认真的考虑

examples.en: The brand's brief flirtation with disco fashion flopped.
examples.zh: 这个品牌对迪斯科风格的短暂尝试搞砸了。

meaning: n. 鹿肉, 野味

examples.en: The bistro serves venison with juniper sauce in autumn.
examples.zh: 这家小馆秋天供应杜松子酱鹿肉。

meaning: n. 君主身分, 王位, 王权;王权, 帝王统治, 君王的身分

examples.en: In this kingdom, the eldest child inherits the kingship.
examples.zh: 在这个王国,长子继承王位。

meaning: n. 乳房切除术;乳房切除术

examples.en: The charity supports women recovering from a mastectomy.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构帮助乳房切除术后的女性康复。

meaning: n. 德国马克（德国货币）

examples.en: Before the euro, German shoppers paid with the deutschmark.
examples.zh: 在欧元之前,德国人购物用德国马克。

meaning: n. 年代史编者, 记录者

examples.en: The monk served as the abbey's chief chronicler for decades.
examples.zh: 这位修道士几十年都是修道院的主要记事者。

meaning: a. 威严的；奥林匹克竞赛的；奥林匹斯山的

examples.en: She became an Olympian at just fifteen years old.
examples.zh: 她十五岁就成为了奥运选手。

meaning: n. 染色工

examples.en: The dyer soaked the wool in deep indigo blue.
examples.zh: 染匠把羊毛浸入深靛蓝色染缸。

meaning: n. 后缀, 下标;vt. 添后缀

examples.en: Add the suffix -ness to turn the adjective into a noun.
examples.zh: 加上后缀ness可以把形容词变成名词。

meaning: n. 调制, 调节, 语调;调制

examples.en: Her gentle modulation of tone kept the lullaby soothing.
examples.zh: 她轻柔的语调变化让摇篮曲格外悦耳。

meaning: n. 韦斯特兰；荷兰西部地区

examples.en: Her father worked at the helicopter plant in Westland.
examples.zh: 她父亲在韦斯特兰的直升机工厂工作。

meaning: n. 诗兴, 诗才

examples.en: In Greek myth, Pegasus is a winged white horse.
examples.zh: 在希腊神话中,珀伽索斯是一匹白色飞马。

meaning: n. 海角

examples.en: The lighthouse stands on a rocky ness north of the harbor.
examples.zh: 灯塔立在港口以北多岩的海角上。

meaning: n. 扣缴税款

examples.en: Her payslip shows tax withholding of two hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 她的工资单显示代扣税款两百美元。

meaning: n. <德>(纳粹时代的)德国空军

examples.en: Archive film shows the Luftwaffe over the city in 1940.
examples.zh: 档案影像记录了1940年德国空军飞临该市。

meaning: n. 戈德温(m.)

examples.en: Godwin wrote one of the earliest political novels in English.
examples.zh: 戈德温写出了英语中最早的政治小说之一。

meaning: n. 莫哈韦沙漠(在美国加利福尼亚西南)

examples.en: They drove across the Mojave with the car windows down.
examples.zh: 他们摇下车窗驾车穿过莫哈韦沙漠。

meaning: n. 拘留;拘留, 收容, 禁闭

examples.en: The exhibition documents the internment of civilians during the war.
examples.zh: 展览记录了战争期间平民被拘押的历史。

meaning: n. 对开纸, 页码, (原稿的)一页;a. 对折的, 对开的

examples.en: The rare play survives in a single folio volume.
examples.zh: 这部罕见的剧作以一册对开本流传至今。

meaning: n. 出租船者, 船夫

examples.en: The boatman rowed the tourists across the calm harbor.
examples.zh: 船夫载着游客划过平静的港湾。

meaning: a. 没有味道的, 没有香味的, 难吃的, 难闻的, 令人不快的, 不可接受的

examples.en: The firm was linked to some unsavory business deals.
examples.zh: 这家公司被曝与一些不光彩的交易有牵连。

meaning: n. 冰山

examples.en: The ship slowed as a berg drifted into the channel.
examples.zh: 一座冰山漂进航道,船放慢了速度。

meaning: 土, 土地

examples.en: The garden pots glow in warm terra cotta tones.
examples.zh: 花盆泛着温暖的陶土色调。

meaning: n. 阿亚图拉（对伊朗等国伊斯兰教什叶派领袖的尊称）

examples.en: The ayatollah addressed the crowds after Friday prayers.
examples.zh: 星期五礼拜后,阿亚图拉向人群讲话。

meaning: n. 萨拉米腊肠(意大利产)

examples.en: He layered salami, cheese, and rocket in the crusty roll.
examples.zh: 他在脆面包里夹了萨拉米、奶酪和芝麻菜。

meaning: n. (象棋)车, 骗子;vt. 骗

examples.en: He moved his rook to control the open file.
examples.zh: 他移动车来控制那条开放的线路。

meaning: n. 雪鞋;vi. 穿雪鞋走路

examples.en: We snowshoe across the fields whenever the snow gets deep.
examples.zh: 每当雪很深,我们就穿雪鞋穿过田野。

meaning: n. 制革工人, 硝皮匠, 六便士

examples.en: The tanner cured the hides in oak barrels behind the shop.
examples.zh: 制革工在店后用橡木桶鞣制皮革。

meaning: int. 呀

examples.en: Jeez, that exam was much harder than I expected.
examples.zh: 天哪,那次考试比我想的难多了。

meaning: a. 不满的, 不忠的, 疏远的

examples.en: Disaffected voters stayed home in large numbers on election day.
examples.zh: 大批心怀不满的选民在投票日待在家里。

meaning: vt. 执行, 司仪, 担任(体育比赛)裁判;vi. 主持宗教仪式, 行使职务

examples.en: The mayor will officiate at the opening ceremony on Friday.
examples.zh: 市长将主持周五的开幕仪式。

meaning: a. 不感兴趣的, 无利害关系的

examples.en: The cat seemed completely uninterested in the expensive new toy.
examples.zh: 猫咪对那个昂贵的新玩具毫无兴趣。

meaning: a. 标题音乐的, 计划性的, 纲领性的

examples.en: The suite is programmatic music describing a storm at sea.
examples.zh: 这部组曲是描绘海上风暴的标题音乐。

meaning: n. 敲击者(或物), 敲门者, 门环;开锤

examples.en: The heavy iron knocker echoed through the silent hall.
examples.zh: 沉重的铁门环在寂静的门厅里回响。

meaning: a. 唯物论的, 唯物主义的

examples.en: He is too materialistic to enjoy a simple walk outdoors.
examples.zh: 他太物质了,连简单的户外散步都体会不到乐趣。

meaning: n. 男巫士, 魔术师;男巫师, 魔法师

examples.en: In the tale, a sorcerer turns the prince into a frog.
examples.zh: 故事里,男巫把王子变成了青蛙。

meaning: n. 达格南（伦敦以前的一行政区）

examples.en: She commutes from Dagenham to central London every weekday.
examples.zh: 她每个工作日从达格南通勤到伦敦市中心。

meaning: n. 师（对罗马天主教等修士的尊称）

examples.en: Dom Paulo brews the abbey's famous dark beer.
examples.zh: 保罗修士酿制修道院著名的黑啤酒。

meaning: n. 稷, 粟, 黍;小米

examples.en: Farmers grow millet in dry areas with poor soil.
examples.zh: 农民在土壤贫瘠的干旱地区种小米。

meaning: a. 引起幻觉的, 荧光的;n. 迷幻剂

examples.en: The poster swirls with psychedelic patterns of pink and lime.
examples.zh: 海报上旋转着粉色和青柠色的迷幻图案。

meaning: 间接数据地址, 交互式数据分析, 智能数据存取;同位素稀释分析

examples.en: The lab applied IDA to measure trace metals in the water.
examples.zh: 实验室用同位素稀释分析测量水中的微量金属。

meaning: n. 大比目鱼

examples.en: The fisherman grilled a thick halibut steak for dinner.
examples.zh: 渔夫晚餐煎了厚厚一块大比目鱼排。

meaning: a. 可估价的

examples.en: The report takes an evaluative look at the new curriculum.
examples.zh: 这份报告对新课程做了评估性审视。

meaning: 魏玛

examples.en: The Bauhaus school was founded in Weimar in 1919.
examples.zh: 包豪斯学校1919年创立于魏玛。

meaning: n. 希腊字母第13字

examples.en: The Greek letter nu stands for frequency in physics formulas.
examples.zh: 希腊字母nu在物理公式中表示频率。

meaning: a. 爆裂似的, 极快的;剖层

examples.en: They are splitting the cost of the farewell gift equally.
examples.zh: 他们平摊告别礼物的费用。

meaning: a. 使徒的

examples.en: The cathedral claims an apostolic foundation going back two thousand years.
examples.zh: 这座大教堂宣称其使徒传承可追溯到两千年前。

meaning: vt. 解开...的钮扣;vi. 解开钮扣

examples.en: He began to unbutton his jacket as the room warmed up.
examples.zh: 屋里暖和起来,他开始解开外套的扣子。

meaning: n. 德文特河（位于澳洲, 英国的河流名）

examples.en: We strolled along the Derwent on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 周日早上我们沿德文特河散步。

meaning: n. 床头板

examples.en: She propped two pillows against the padded headboard to read.
examples.zh: 她靠着软包床头板垫了两个枕头看书。

meaning: adv. 道歉地, 辩解地

examples.en: He arrived late and spoke apologetically to the whole room.
examples.zh: 他迟到了,满怀歉意地向大家说明。

meaning: n. 毫秒;毫秒

examples.en: The sprinter won the race by a single millisecond.
examples.zh: 短跑运动员以一毫秒之差夺冠。

meaning: n. 没收, 充公;没收, 查抄, 徵用

examples.en: The confiscation of phones at the exam surprised nobody.
examples.zh: 考试没收手机,没人感到意外。

meaning: n. 先买, 先买权;预先占有, 优先购买权, 抢先购买

examples.en: The clause gives early investors a right of preemption over new shares.
examples.zh: 该条款赋予早期投资者对新股的优先认购权。

meaning: n. （受过偷窃技术专门训练被雇作间谍或刺客的）日本武士

examples.en: My nephew dressed as a ninja for the school costume party.
examples.zh: 我侄子在学校化装舞会上扮成忍者。

meaning: n. 伯恩利（英国城市）；伯恩利队（足球俱乐部）

examples.en: Burnley conceded a late goal and lost the cup tie.
examples.zh: 伯恩利临近终场失球,输掉了杯赛。

meaning: adv. 斜地, 成十字状地, 交叉地;十字形向, 横向

examples.en: Cut the sandwich crosswise so the twins can share it.
examples.zh: 把三明治横着切开,好让双胞胎分着吃。

meaning: a. 塞浦路斯的, 塞浦路斯语的, 塞浦路斯人的;n. 塞浦路斯人, 塞浦路斯语

examples.en: She ordered a Cypriot salad with grilled halloumi cheese.
examples.zh: 她点了配烤哈罗米奶酪的塞浦路斯沙拉。

meaning: n. 原料

examples.en: The plant turns corn and straw into feedstock for bioplastics.
examples.zh: 工厂把玉米和秸秆变成生物塑料的原料。

meaning: 迈尔(热容单位)

examples.en: The vintage textbook measured heat capacity in mayer units.
examples.zh: 那本旧教科书用迈尔为单位表示热容。

meaning: n. 猎鸟

examples.en: In winter, thousands of wildfowl gather on the shallow lake.
examples.zh: 冬天,成千上万的水禽聚集在浅湖上。

meaning: 耿氏

examples.en: The speed gun uses a Gunn diode to emit microwaves.
examples.zh: 测速仪用耿氏二极管发射微波。

meaning: n. 硅藻土;硅藻岩

examples.en: Their freighter put in at Tripoli for fuel and supplies.
examples.zh: 他们的货轮在的黎波里停靠补给燃料和物资。

meaning: 三菱

examples.en: The lecture hall got a new Mitsubishi projector last week.
examples.zh: 报告厅上周装了一台新的三菱投影仪。

meaning: n. 归化, 移入, 移植;入籍, 归化

examples.en: She passed the exam and completed her naturalization last spring.
examples.zh: 她通过了考试,去年春天办完了入籍手续。

meaning: n. 住在美国的墨西哥男人, 奇卡诺人

examples.en: The course explores Chicano literature of the American Southwest.
examples.zh: 这门课探讨美国西南部的奇卡诺文学。

meaning: a. 过热的;v. 使过热, 变得过热( overheat的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: The old van overheated on the long climb up the pass.
examples.zh: 旧货车在长长的爬坡途中过热了。

meaning: a. 子宫的, 同母异父的;子宫的

examples.en: The scan checks uterine health during the second trimester.
examples.zh: 扫描检查孕中期的子宫健康状况。

meaning: 髓盖, 盖髓术, 盖髓物

examples.en: Builders finished capping the garden wall with flat stones.
examples.zh: 工人们用扁平的石头给院墙封了顶。

meaning: n. 结婚生活;婚姻

examples.en: Parish records list many children born outside wedlock in that era.
examples.zh: 教区档案记载那个年代有许多非婚生的孩子。

meaning: n. 入坞;(煤的)灰分评价

examples.en: The cargo capsule completed docking with the space station.
examples.zh: 货运飞船完成了与空间站的对接。

meaning: n. 甘蔗, 糖蔗

examples.en: Fields of sugarcane stretch for miles along the warm coast.
examples.zh: 温暖的海岸边,甘蔗田绵延数英里。

meaning: n. 球童;vi. 当球童

examples.en: He worked as a caddie at the golf club all summer.
examples.zh: 他整个夏天都在高尔夫俱乐部当球童。

meaning: n. 起电, 带电, 电气化;起电

examples.en: Railway electrification will cut diesel use on the coastal line.
examples.zh: 铁路电气化将减少沿海线路的柴油消耗。

meaning: 筏运

examples.en: The group went white-water rafting down the wild river.
examples.zh: 一行人顺着湍急的河流漂流而下。

meaning: a. 依照性别而分类的

examples.en: The toy store dropped its gendered signs after customer feedback.
examples.zh: 玩具店在顾客反馈后撤掉了按性别分类的标牌。

meaning: n. 伞兵

examples.en: The paratrooper landed softly in the open field below.
examples.zh: 伞兵平稳地落在下面的空地上。

meaning: interj. 咄!, 啊!, 呸!

examples.en: Ugh, this traffic jam is going to make us late.
examples.zh: 唉,这场堵车要让我们迟到了。

meaning: n. 生理学者;生理学家

examples.en: The physiologist studies how human muscles adapt to endurance exercise.
examples.zh: 这位生理学家研究人体肌肉如何适应耐力运动。

meaning: n. 周围, 范围, 界限, 领域

examples.en: Pay disputes fall within the ambit of the review board.
examples.zh: 工资纠纷属于审查委员会的职权范围。

meaning: n. 笨人, 呆子, 笨拙的人;vi. 痴呆着看

examples.en: Tourists gawk at the giant chandelier in the hotel lobby.
examples.zh: 游客们盯着酒店大堂的巨型吊灯看个不停。

meaning: a. 离子的, 爱奥尼亚的, 爱奥尼亚韵律的, 爱奥尼亚式的;n. 爱奥尼亚方言

examples.en: The museum entrance is framed by tall Ionic columns.
examples.zh: 博物馆入口两侧是高大的爱奥尼亚式柱子。

meaning: n. 新闻广播员, 新闻评论广播员

examples.en: The newscaster announced the storm warning during the noon bulletin.
examples.zh: 新闻播音员在午间公报里播报了风暴警报。

meaning: n. 扭结, 蜷缩;v. (使)扭结, (使)绞缠

examples.en: A kink in the garden hose stopped the water flowing.
examples.zh: 花园水管打了个结,水就不流了。

meaning: n. 永世, 万古

examples.en: The desert landscape took eons of wind and sand to form.
examples.zh: 这片沙漠地貌是风沙亿万年的产物。

meaning: n. 苏格拉底

examples.en: Socrates taught his students by asking them careful questions.
examples.zh: 苏格拉底通过提问来教导学生。

meaning: n. 石芽；石灰岩岩脊；岩沟

examples.en: The hikers crossed a clint ridge of weathered limestone.
examples.zh: 徒步者翻越了一道风化石灰岩脊。

meaning: n. 波希米亚

examples.en: He moved to Bohemia to learn traditional glassblowing.
examples.zh: 他搬到波希米亚学习传统玻璃吹制。

meaning: adv. 极其丰富地, 大量地

examples.en: He apologized profusely for arriving nearly an hour late.
examples.zh: 他为迟到近一小时连声道歉。

meaning: n. 国民兵, 民兵

examples.en: Each militiaman carried his own rifle to the Sunday muster.
examples.zh: 每个民兵都自带步枪参加周日集合。

meaning: n. 马龙

examples.en: Malone scored the winning basket in the final seconds.
examples.zh: 马龙在最后几秒投进制胜一球。

meaning: n. 宝贝, 小家伙

examples.en: Cheer up, sonny, the next bus is coming soon.
examples.zh: 高兴点,小家伙,下一班车马上就到。

meaning: int. 哈, 嘿

examples.en: Hah, I knew our team would win the match.
examples.zh: 哈,我就知道我们队会赢。

meaning: 分类归并; 聚类

examples.en: The map shows customers clustering around the two big malls.
examples.zh: 地图显示顾客集中在两个大商场附近。

meaning: n. 滑雪板

examples.en: She learned to snowboard during the winter holidays in the Alps.
examples.zh: 她在阿尔卑斯山的寒假里学会了单板滑雪。

meaning: 比利牛斯山脉

examples.en: The hiking trail crosses the Pyrenees into northern Spain.
examples.zh: 这条徒步路线翻越比利牛斯山进入西班牙北部。

meaning: n. 迪斯尼乐园

examples.en: The kids begged to visit Disneyland during the California trip.
examples.zh: 孩子们恳求在加州之行中去迪士尼乐园。

meaning: n. 光辉, 发光, 容光焕发;闪光

examples.en: The bride's radiance lit up the whole tiny chapel.
examples.zh: 新娘容光焕发,照亮了整座小教堂。

meaning: n. 褐砂石, 褐砂石建筑;a. 有钱人的

examples.en: They bought a narrow brownstone near the Brooklyn park.
examples.zh: 他们在布鲁克林公园附近买了一栋褐石屋。

meaning: 私人秘书, (露天)扩音系统;程序存取, 程序地址, 程序分析

examples.en: Pa taught me to fish on quiet summer mornings.
examples.zh: 爸爸在安静的夏日清晨教我钓鱼。

meaning: n. 破坏, 破损处, 破损量;破裂; 断裂

examples.en: The insurance covers breakage of glassware during delivery.
examples.zh: 保险涵盖运输途中玻璃器皿的破损。

meaning: n. 海牛

examples.en: Tourists watched a slow manatee graze on sea grass.
examples.zh: 游客看着一只慢悠悠的海牛啃食海草。

meaning: n. 利口酒;香酒

examples.en: She added a splash of cherry liqueur to the cake batter.
examples.zh: 她往蛋糕糊里加了一点樱桃利口酒。

meaning: 双胎, 双生子

examples.en: Gemini is easy to spot in the clear winter sky.
examples.zh: 晴朗的冬夜里很容易找到双子座。

meaning: n. 箭鱼

examples.en: The menu features swordfish steak with lemon and herbs.
examples.zh: 菜单上有配柠檬和香草的剑鱼排。

meaning: n. 物力论, 力本说;动力说, 动力病原论

examples.en: Her energy and dynamism made the training session enjoyable.
examples.zh: 她的活力和干劲让培训课很愉快。

meaning: n. 弗隆(英国长度单位)

examples.en: The lead horse pulled clear in the final furlong.
examples.zh: 领头的马在最后一弗隆甩开了对手。

meaning: n. 金牛星座, 金牛宫

examples.en: The bright orange star in Taurus is called Aldebaran.
examples.zh: 金牛座里那颗橙亮的星叫毕宿五。

meaning: a. 无法支撑的, 不能忍受的, 不可证实的;未能证实的, 不能成立的

examples.en: Running the team on constant overtime is simply unsustainable.
examples.zh: 靠不断加班来运转团队根本不可持续。

meaning: n. 伍德斯托克音乐节（每年8月在纽约州东南部Woodstock举行的摇滚音乐节）

examples.en: Her parents drove to Woodstock for the legendary festival.
examples.zh: 她父母开车去伍德斯托克参加了那届传奇音乐节。

meaning: n. 莱比锡城

examples.en: The trade fair in Leipzig opens next Monday morning.
examples.zh: 莱比锡博览会下周一上午开幕。

meaning: n. 阿普比（英国英格兰西北部小镇）

examples.en: We stopped in Appleby for tea and warm scones.
examples.zh: 我们在阿普比停留,喝了茶吃了热司康饼。

meaning: n. 勺子, 长柄勺;vt. 以勺舀取, 以勺掬, 不分对象予以赠送

examples.en: She used the long ladle to fill the soup bowls.
examples.zh: 她用长柄勺把汤盛进碗里。

meaning: n. 开动者, 激励者, 致动器;传动装置, 驱动器, 激励器

examples.en: A small actuator opens the greenhouse windows when it gets hot.
examples.zh: 天热时,一个小驱动器会打开温室的窗户。

meaning: a. 非法的, 违法的

examples.en: The frontier town was lawless during its first rough decade.
examples.zh: 拓荒小镇最初十年治安混乱、无法无天。

meaning: n. <主英>=decentralization

examples.en: The party promised the decentralisation of power to the regions.
examples.zh: 该政党承诺把权力下放到各地区。

meaning: 植物界的, 植物学的

examples.en: We spent the afternoon wandering through the botanic garden.
examples.zh: 我们在植物园里逛了一下午。

meaning: n. 除臭药, 防臭剂;a. 止臭的, 防臭的

examples.en: He grabbed his keys, phone, and deodorant before rushing out.
examples.zh: 他抓起钥匙、手机和除臭剂就冲了出去。

meaning: n. 婴儿内衣（无袖, 两肩常用纽扣）

examples.en: Aunt Gertrude sends us homemade jam every Christmas.
examples.zh: 格特鲁德姑妈每年圣诞都给我们寄自制果酱。

meaning: n. 阿曼

examples.en: Divers explore colorful coral reefs off the coast of Oman.
examples.zh: 潜水者在阿曼近海探索五彩斑斓的珊瑚礁。

meaning: n. 耶利米(<<圣经>>故事人物), <<耶利米书>>

examples.en: Jeremiah warned the city to change its careless ways.
examples.zh: 耶利米警告那座城要改掉轻率的行为。

meaning: n. 科捏克上等白兰地;法国白兰地

examples.en: Grandfather sips a small glass of cognac after Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 祖父周日晚餐后小酌一杯白兰地。

meaning: a. 八边形的, 八角形的

examples.en: An octagonal clock tower stands in the old market square.
examples.zh: 老集市广场上矗立着一座八角钟楼。

meaning: 联合国教育科学及文化组织, 联合国教科文组织

examples.en: The old town became a UNESCO site in 1997.
examples.zh: 这座老城于1997年入选世界遗产名录。

meaning: a. 像天鹅绒的, 轻软光滑的, 柔和的, 平和的

examples.en: The dessert has a velvety texture with a hint of caramel.
examples.zh: 这道甜点口感丝滑,还带一丝焦糖香。

meaning: 格温内思郡

examples.en: They rented a stone cottage in Gwynedd for August.
examples.zh: 他们在格温内思租了间石屋度八月。

meaning: n. 后悔, 悔改;悔改, 悔悟, 后悔

examples.en: The old priest spoke gently about repentance and forgiveness.
examples.zh: 老神父温和地讲述悔改与宽恕。

meaning: n. 牡丹(花), 芍药(花)

examples.en: A pale pink peony opened beside the front steps.
examples.zh: 台阶旁开了一朵浅粉色牡丹。

meaning: 波厄斯郡

examples.en: Powys covers some of the wildest hills in Wales.
examples.zh: 波厄斯有威尔士最荒凉的一些山地。

meaning: n. 伯灵顿, 柏林顿（美国地名）

examples.en: We browsed the bookshops on Church Street in Burlington.
examples.zh: 我们在伯灵顿教堂街的书店逛了逛。

meaning: n. 驱逐, 撵走, 剥夺;驱逐, 撵走, 剥夺

examples.en: The board voted for the ouster of the chief executive.
examples.zh: 董事会投票罢免了首席执行官。

meaning: adv. 怯懦地, 羞怯地; 愚蠢地

examples.en: He sheepishly admitted he had lost the office keys again.
examples.zh: 他不好意思地承认又弄丢了办公室钥匙。

meaning: 模式带

examples.en: Volunteers finished banding the young birds before releasing them.
examples.zh: 志愿者给幼鸟做完环志后放飞了它们。

meaning: a. 胞囊的, 膀胱的, 胆囊的;囊的; 胆囊的; 膀胱的

examples.en: The clinic offers special care for children with cystic fibrosis.
examples.zh: 这家诊所为囊性纤维化患儿提供专门护理。

meaning: n. 性急的人, 暴躁的人

examples.en: Young Hotspur charged ahead without waiting for any orders.
examples.zh: 性急的霍茨浦没等命令就冲了出去。

meaning: n. 奥布里(m.)

examples.en: Aubrey offered to water the plants while we were away.
examples.zh: 我们不在时,奥布里主动帮忙浇花。

meaning: n. 马雅人, 马雅语;a. 马雅人的, 马雅语的

examples.en: The Maya built great stone cities deep in the jungle.
examples.zh: 玛雅人在丛林深处建起巨大的石头城市。

meaning: n. 绿头鸭, 绿头鸭肉

examples.en: A mallard and her ducklings swam across the pond.
examples.zh: 一只绿头鸭带着小鸭子游过池塘。

meaning: n. 看不见, 难觉察的, 看不见的东西

examples.en: The frog's near invisibility hides it from hungry birds.
examples.zh: 那只蛙几乎隐形,躲开了饥饿的鸟。

meaning: n. 水果干布丁, 细煤, 煤屑, 无用的东西;vt. 把...弄得像新的一样, 把...改头换面

examples.en: Grandma served warm plum duff after the Sunday roast.
examples.zh: 周日烤肉之后,奶奶端上热乎乎的葡萄干布丁。

meaning: n. 至上主义者

examples.en: The documentary follows a former supremacist on a new path.
examples.zh: 纪录片讲述一名昔日至上主义者走上新路。

meaning: adv. 顺从地；服从地；忠顺地

examples.en: The sheepdog obediently herded the lambs toward the gate.
examples.zh: 牧羊犬听话地把羊羔赶向栅门。

meaning: a. 未被认出的, 未被认定的, 未被承认的

examples.en: The famous actress walked through the crowd completely unrecognized.
examples.zh: 这位名演员穿过人群,完全没人认出她。

meaning: 喷镀; 喷涂;喷雾, 喷水

examples.en: The farmer was spraying the orchard to protect the young apples.
examples.zh: 农民正在给果园喷药,保护幼果。

meaning: 解调器

examples.en: The engineer replaced the faulty dem inside the radio receiver.
examples.zh: 工程师更换了收音机里故障的解调器。

meaning: n. 切断, 毁损;残毁, 残缺

examples.en: The treaty banned the mutilation of prisoners taken in war.
examples.zh: 条约禁止对战俘施以残害。

meaning: n. 铬;铬Cr

examples.en: The bathroom faucet is plated with shiny chromium.
examples.zh: 浴室水龙头镀着闪亮的铬。

meaning: 泰赛德区

examples.en: The famous bridge at Tayside closed during the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴期间,泰赛德的大桥封闭了。

meaning: n. 构成派造型艺术家

examples.en: The gallery hangs a bold constructivist poster from 1924.
examples.zh: 美术馆挂着一张1924年大胆的构成派海报。

meaning: n. 封建主义, 封建制度

examples.en: The museum explains how feudalism shaped daily village life.
examples.zh: 博物馆讲解封建制度如何影响村民的日常生活。

meaning: n. 托洛茨基（前苏联托洛茨基集团领袖, 后被开除出党）

examples.en: Trotsky was exiled from the Soviet Union in 1929.
examples.zh: 托洛茨基于1929年被流放出苏联。

meaning: n. 斜纹呢衬裙, 一种镶花边的鞋

examples.en: The royal family retreats to Balmoral every late summer.
examples.zh: 王室每年夏末都去巴尔莫勒尔避暑。

meaning: 鲁昂(法国港市)

examples.en: Monet painted the cathedral at Rouen again and again.
examples.zh: 莫奈一次又一次地画鲁昂大教堂。

meaning: n. 爆竹, 鞭炮;爆竹; 鞭炮

examples.en: The boys set off a firecracker behind the school gym.
examples.zh: 男孩们在学校体育馆后面放了一个爆竹。

meaning: n. 锡克教教徒

examples.en: A Sikh classmate invited us to the spring temple festival.
examples.zh: 一位锡克教同学邀请我们参加春季寺庙节。

meaning: n. 抗议者, 持异议者, 拒付者;(期票等的)拒付者, 抗议者

examples.en: A protestor waved a handmade banner outside the town hall.
examples.zh: 一名抗议者在市政厅外挥舞自制的横幅。

meaning: n. 结婚, 结亲, 婚礼;a. 结婚的

examples.en: The workshop covers spousal rights under the new pension law.
examples.zh: 讲座介绍新养老金法下的配偶权利。

meaning: n. 马尼拉

examples.en: She filed the signed contract in a thick manila folder.
examples.zh: 她把签好的合同放进厚厚的马尼拉纸文件夹。

meaning: a. 癌的, 似癌的, 生癌的;癌性的

examples.en: The biopsy showed the small growth was not cancerous.
examples.zh: 活检显示那个小肿块不是恶性的。

meaning: n. 汽车制造商

examples.en: The carmaker will release its first electric van next year.
examples.zh: 这家汽车制造商明年将推出首款电动厢式车。

meaning: n. 涉水者, 涉禽, 高统防水长靴

examples.en: The birdwatcher spotted a wader probing the mud for worms.
examples.zh: 观鸟者看到一只涉禽在泥里觅虫。

meaning: 接头处

examples.en: He scored the winning points with an easy layup.
examples.zh: 他以一记轻松的上篮拿下制胜分。

meaning: n. 船工, 船家, 船夫, 划手

examples.en: The old waterman knows every current in the estuary.
examples.zh: 老船工熟悉河口的每一股水流。

meaning: n. 驾帆船, 风帆比赛, 乘游艇航行, 驾驶快艇

examples.en: They spent two weeks yachting along the rocky coastline.
examples.zh: 他们沿着多岩的海岸驾帆船游了两周。

meaning: n. 巫师, 占卜者, 祭师

examples.en: Legend says a druid blessed the ancient standing stones.
examples.zh: 传说一位德鲁伊祭司为古立石赐福。

meaning: a. 笨重的, 粗陋的

examples.en: A hulking security guard stood quietly by the stage door.
examples.zh: 一名高大魁梧的保安安静地守在后台门口。

meaning: a. 未发现的, 未被发觉的, 尚不为人所知的

examples.en: The band's early recordings lay undiscovered for nearly twenty years.
examples.zh: 这支乐队早期的录音尘封了近二十年。

meaning: n. 海顿

examples.en: The orchestra performed a lively symphony by Haydn.
examples.zh: 乐团演奏了海顿一部轻快的交响曲。

meaning: n. 伐木者, 伐木机, 平缝工, 平缝装置, 接缝工, (非正式)伙伴, (非正式)家伙

examples.en: The old feller swung his axe at the pine trunk.
examples.zh: 老伐木工抡起斧头砍向松树干。

meaning: a. 最大的, 最高的;最大的, 最高的

examples.en: The coach demanded maximal effort during the final ten minutes.
examples.zh: 教练要求最后十分钟全力以赴。

meaning: n. 索非亚（保加利亚首都）

examples.en: Sofia is famous for its huge gilded cathedral.
examples.zh: 索非亚以巨大的镀金大教堂闻名。

meaning: n. 划独木舟, 玩独木舟

examples.en: We went canoeing on the glassy lake at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分我们在平静如镜的湖上划独木舟。

meaning: slay的过去分词

examples.en: The old ballad tells of a knight slain in battle.
examples.zh: 古老的歌谣讲述一位骑士战死沙场。

meaning: n. 科林斯人, 花花公子, 业余运动家;a. 科林斯的, 古希腊科林斯式的, 科林斯人的

examples.en: The temple porch is lined with ornate Corinthian columns.
examples.zh: 神庙门廊立着一排华丽的科林斯式柱子。

meaning: n. 比萨城

examples.en: Tourists ride the train to Pisa to see the tower.
examples.zh: 游客乘火车去比萨看斜塔。

meaning: n. 英国议会议事录;英国议会议事录

examples.en: The quote appears in Hansard from the 1988 budget debate.
examples.zh: 这段引文出自1988年预算辩论的议事录。

meaning: n. 图卢兹（法国南部城市）

examples.en: He spent a year studying aerospace engineering in Toulouse.
examples.zh: 他在图卢兹学了一年航空航天工程。

meaning: n. 江河中行驶的船

examples.en: The old riverboat carried cotton down the muddy river.
examples.zh: 这艘老内河船曾载着棉花顺浑浊的河而下。

meaning: n. 犯罪, 有罪, 犯罪行为;有罪, 犯罪行为, 犯罪性

examples.en: The youth program aims to steer teens away from criminality.
examples.zh: 这个青少年项目旨在引导孩子远离犯罪。

meaning: n. 法学家, 法律学者, 法律著作家;法学家, 律师, 法官

examples.en: A leading jurist questioned the fairness of the new rule.
examples.zh: 一位权威法学家质疑新规定的公正性。

meaning: n. 鲍伊猎刀

examples.en: The scout sharpened his bowie knife by the campfire.
examples.zh: 童子军在营火旁磨他的鲍伊猎刀。

meaning: a. 会众的, 公理教会的

examples.en: The choir leads the congregational singing every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 唱诗班每周日上午领唱会众诗歌。

meaning: 信号物

examples.en: In that city, a red door is a signifier of welcome.
examples.zh: 在那座城市,红门是欢迎的象征。

meaning: n. 探路者, 开拓者, 探索者, 导航人员, 导航飞机, 导航雷达;维修指南

examples.en: The app acts as a pathfinder for new students on campus.
examples.zh: 这款应用为新生的校园生活指路。

meaning: a. 剥去的

examples.en: The room was stripped bare before the painters arrived.
examples.zh: 油漆工来之前,房间被腾空了。

meaning: a. 圣经的, 依据圣经的

examples.en: The debate turned on scriptural passages about charity and justice.
examples.zh: 辩论围绕圣经中关于慈善与公义的经文展开。

meaning: n. （牛津大学的）贝列尔学院

examples.en: He won a place at Balliol to read history.
examples.zh: 他考入贝列尔学院攻读历史。

meaning: n. 腰带, 束腰带

examples.en: The waistband of his jeans feels tighter after the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期过后,他牛仔裤的腰身紧了。

meaning: vi.vt. (仅用于主语为I时,后加宾语从句)(我)想, 也许

examples.en: I daresay the meeting will run late again tonight.
examples.zh: 我看今晚的会又要开到很晚。

meaning: n. 实习科目, 实习课

examples.en: Her teaching practicum begins at the local high school.
examples.zh: 她的教学实习在当地一所高中开始。

meaning: a. 赤裸裸描写性行为的

examples.en: Only the most hardcore fans stayed for the third encore.
examples.zh: 只有最铁杆的歌迷还留着等第三次返场。

meaning: n. 冠, 冠状物, 副冠, 根颈, 头顶, 牙冠, 檐板, 日冕, 月华, 日华, 电晕, 光圈;电晕, 冠

examples.en: During the eclipse we saw the sun's glowing corona.
examples.zh: 日食时我们看到了太阳发光的日冕。

meaning: a. 不能医治的, 不能矫正的, 无救的;n. 不治的病人, 无救的人

examples.en: He has an incurable optimism about the team's chances.
examples.zh: 他对球队的机会有着无法动摇的乐观。

meaning: a. 不易弯曲的, 不屈的

examples.en: The unyielding rock made digging the trench slow, tiring work.
examples.zh: 岩石坚硬难掘,挖沟又慢又累。

meaning: n. 贝尔蒙（一种烟的名字）；贝尔蒙特（酒店名）

examples.en: The two-day conference was held at a hotel in Belmont.
examples.zh: 为期两天的会议在贝尔蒙特的一家酒店举行。

meaning: vt. 使平凡, 使琐碎

examples.en: It is wrong to trivialize the sacrifices of these nurses.
examples.zh: 把这些护士的牺牲不当回事是不对的。

meaning: n. 纤路

examples.en: We cycled slowly along the towpath beside the old canal.
examples.zh: 我们沿着老运河边的纤道慢慢骑行。

meaning: n. 外屋, 户外厕所

examples.en: The mountain cabin has no plumbing, just an outhouse behind the pines.
examples.zh: 山间小屋没有管道,松树后只有一间户外厕所。

meaning: n. 过氧化物;过氧化物

examples.en: The nurse cleaned the small cut with peroxide before bandaging it.
examples.zh: 护士先用过氧化氢给小伤口消毒再包扎。

meaning: n. 命令

examples.en: The inquiry opened at the behest of the transport minister.
examples.zh: 应交通部长的要求,调查启动了。

meaning: n. 坚实细腻的黄色干酪;赛达酪(英国产的一种干酪)

examples.en: He melted sharp cheddar over warm toast for lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐他在热吐司上化了浓浓的切达干酪。

meaning: n. 社会化

examples.en: Kindergarten plays a big role in the socialisation of children.
examples.zh: 幼儿园在儿童社会化中作用很大。

meaning: a. 移情作用的；同感的（等于empathic）

examples.en: An empathetic listener makes upset customers feel truly heard.
examples.zh: 会共情的倾听者能让不满的顾客感到被理解。

meaning: n. 马洛（英国剧作家及诗人）

examples.en: Marlowe wrote for the London stage a few years before Shakespeare.
examples.zh: 马洛比莎士比亚早几年为伦敦舞台写戏。

meaning: v. 发咝咝声( sizzle的现在分词 ); 表现良好, 进行顺利; 把…烧得哧哧响, 烧焦; 恶言相骂

examples.en: The chef tossed the peppers into the sizzling wok.
examples.zh: 厨师把辣椒扔进滚烫的锅里。

meaning: n. 封闭工厂;封锁

examples.en: The club owners imposed a lockout after talks collapsed.
examples.zh: 谈判破裂后,俱乐部老板实施了停工。

meaning: vi. 流浪

examples.en: They would rather gipsy around Europe than settle in one city.
examples.zh: 他们宁愿在欧洲流浪,也不愿定居一城。

meaning: a. 杂乱的, 混杂的, 混淆的

examples.en: Doctors criticized the promiscuous use of antibiotics on factory farms.
examples.zh: 医生批评养殖场滥用抗生素。

meaning: n. 紧身褡, 妇女的胸衣;围腰, 胸衣

examples.en: The costume collection includes a silk corset from the 1890s.
examples.zh: 服饰藏品中有一件十九世纪九十年代的丝绸紧身褡。

meaning: a. 角的, 似角一样坚硬的, 角质的, 老茧的;角性的, 角的

examples.en: The beetle is protected by a hard, horny shell.
examples.zh: 甲虫靠坚硬的角质外壳保护自己。

meaning: a. 空气动力学的

examples.en: The car's smooth aerodynamic body reduces wind noise at speed.
examples.zh: 汽车流线型的车身降低了高速风噪。

meaning: n. 农奴, 奴隶, 服苦役的人

examples.en: Under feudal law, a serf farmed the lord's land for protection.
examples.zh: 在封建法律下,农奴为换取保护而耕种领主的土地。

meaning: n. 地方长官;v. 穿(绳索), 穿过

examples.en: The climber learned to reeve the rope through the pulley.
examples.zh: 攀岩者学着把绳子穿过滑轮。

meaning: n. 哲基尔医生(英国小说<<化身博士>>的主人工)

examples.en: The novel contrasts the gentle Jekyll with the wild Hyde.
examples.zh: 小说把温和的哲基尔和狂野的海德形成对照。

meaning: v. 漂洗( rinse的过去式和过去分词 ); 冲洗; 用清水漂洗掉（肥皂泡等）; （用清水）冲掉

examples.en: She rinsed the shampoo from her hair with warm water.
examples.zh: 她用温水把头发上的洗发水冲净。

meaning: a. 起涟漪的, 潺潺流水般声音的

examples.en: The stone sent rippling circles across the still pond.
examples.zh: 石子在静止的池塘里激起层层涟漪。

meaning: vt. 提出请愿书, 纪念

examples.en: The town raised a statue to memorialize the local heroes.
examples.zh: 小镇立了一座雕像纪念当地的英雄。

meaning: n. 主教的职位, 主教的辖区

examples.en: He was appointed to a northern bishopric at Easter.
examples.zh: 复活节时他被任命为北方教区主教。

meaning: adv. 讽刺地, 挖苦地

examples.en: He thanked his brother sarcastically for the broken umbrella.
examples.zh: 他阴阳怪气地感谢弟弟送来破伞。

meaning: 空中客车

examples.en: The airline added a new Airbus route to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 这家航空公司新开了飞东京的空客航线。

meaning: 多巴胺

examples.en: Exercise releases dopamine, which naturally lifts your mood.
examples.zh: 运动释放多巴胺,能自然改善心情。

meaning: n. 空袭；空中打击

examples.en: Reports described an airstrike near the border at dawn.
examples.zh: 有报道称黎明时分边境附近遭到空袭。

meaning: n. 伊莱亚斯（希伯来先知, 等于Elijah）

examples.en: Elias fixed the leaking kitchen sink within the hour.
examples.zh: 伊莱亚斯一小时内就修好了漏水的厨房水槽。

meaning: n. 独立制片人, 独立制作的影(唱)片

examples.en: She prefers indie films to big studio blockbusters.
examples.zh: 比起大片厂的爆米花电影,她更喜欢独立电影。

meaning: n. 著明人士

examples.en: He dreamed of becoming a celeb before turning twenty.
examples.zh: 他梦想在二十岁前成名。

meaning: n. 未来派画家, 未来主义者

examples.en: The futurist predicts coastal cities will ban private cars.
examples.zh: 这位未来学家预测沿海城市将禁行私家车。

meaning: n. 从事安装的人, 调节器, (警察)眼线

examples.en: The setter placed the ball perfectly for the winning spike.
examples.zh: 二传手把球传得恰到好处,助队扣杀得分。

meaning: n. 高坛

examples.en: The choir stands in the chancel during the evening service.
examples.zh: 晚祷时唱诗班站在圣坛区。

meaning: n. 曲柄, 绞车;vt. 用绞盘拉

examples.en: The crew used a winch to haul the boat ashore.
examples.zh: 船员用绞车把船拖上岸。

meaning: n. 竞技比武大会

examples.en: The children begged for one more ride on the carousel.
examples.zh: 孩子们央求再坐一次旋转木马。

meaning: n. 托利党党员, 保守党员, 亲英分子;a. 保守分子的

examples.en: He has voted Tory in every election since 1990.
examples.zh: 自1990年以来他每次选举都投保守党。

meaning: n. 蝉

examples.en: The loud cicada droned on through the hot afternoon.
examples.zh: 炎热的午后,蝉鸣声吵个不停。

meaning: interj. 呸(表示轻蔑、嫌恶)

examples.en: Pugh, what is that awful smell in the kitchen?
examples.zh: 呸,厨房里是什么怪味?

meaning: n. (=Magdalene)从良的妓女, 妓女收容所

examples.en: The choir of Magdalen sings from the tower at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时,莫德林学院唱诗班在塔上歌唱。

meaning: n. 袋狼, 残酷的人, 贪婪的人

examples.en: The hyena's strange laugh echoed across the dark savanna.
examples.zh: 鬣狗怪异的笑声回荡在黑夜的草原上。

meaning: v. 恢复( rally的现在分词 ); 价格回升; 集合起来; 嘲笑

examples.en: The captain gave a rallying speech before the cup final.
examples.zh: 队长在杯赛决赛前做了鼓舞士气的讲话。

meaning: n. 鲟鱼

examples.en: The great river was once famous for its giant sturgeon.
examples.zh: 这条大河曾以巨大的鲟鱼闻名。

meaning: n. 化疗

examples.en: Grandpa stayed cheerful throughout his chemo treatments last year.
examples.zh: 爷爷去年化疗期间一直很乐观。

meaning: n. 石垛工；煤矿井下充填工

examples.en: The waller rebuilt the dry stone wall without any mortar.
examples.zh: 砌墙匠不用灰浆重砌了这道干石墙。

meaning: a. 无称号的, 无标题的, 无合法权利的

examples.en: The show includes several untitled sketches by the late artist.
examples.zh: 展览包括这位已故画家的几幅无题素描。

meaning: n. 海地

examples.en: She volunteered at a rural clinic in Haiti last summer.
examples.zh: 她去年夏天在海地的一家乡村诊所做志愿者。

meaning: n. 武士

examples.en: The museum displays armor once worn by a samurai lord.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出一位武士大名穿过的铠甲。

meaning: a. 不能防守的, 不能维持的, 支持不住的, (主张等)站不住脚的

examples.en: His board position became untenable after the leaked emails.
examples.zh: 邮件泄露后,他在董事会的职位保不住了。

meaning: v. 弄皱, 使凌乱( rumple的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: His rumpled suit suggested he had slept at the office.
examples.zh: 他皱巴巴的西装说明他在办公室过夜了。

meaning: n. (=naught)邪恶, 恶人

examples.en: There is nowt wrong with an honest day's work.
examples.zh: 踏踏实实干一天活没什么不好。

meaning: n. 软体动物;软体动物

examples.en: A tiny mollusc clung tightly to the wet rock.
examples.zh: 一只小软体动物紧紧贴在湿岩石上。

meaning: n. 麻木, 麻醉;感觉缺失, 麻木, 麻醉

examples.en: The patient slept deeply under anaesthesia during the operation.
examples.zh: 手术中病人在麻醉下沉睡。

meaning: n. 杂耍, 轻歌舞剧

examples.en: Her great-grandfather performed comic songs in vaudeville theaters.
examples.zh: 她的曾祖父在杂耍剧院表演滑稽歌曲。

meaning: int. 啊呀!

examples.en: Blimey, did you see the size of that fish?
examples.zh: 哎呀,你看到那条鱼有多大了吗?

meaning: n. 葡萄藤, 葡萄树, 秘密情报网

examples.en: News of the merger spread through the office grapevine within hours.
examples.zh: 合并的消息几小时内就通过小道消息传遍了公司。

meaning: n. 三个一组, 燕鸥

examples.en: An Arctic tern swooped low over the shimmering water.
examples.zh: 一只北极燕鸥掠过波光粼粼的水面。

meaning: n. 福尔柯克（英国苏格兰中部城市）

examples.en: The great wheel at Falkirk lifts boats between two canals.
examples.zh: 福尔柯克大轮把船在两条运河间升降。

meaning: n. 吸入;吸入剂, 吸入

examples.en: Slow inhalation through the nose helps calm your nerves.
examples.zh: 用鼻子慢慢吸气有助于平复情绪。

meaning: n. 布商

examples.en: The draper sold her fine linen for the new curtains.
examples.zh: 布商卖给她做新窗帘的细亚麻布。

meaning: n. (女性衬衫)的胸襟, (小孩的)围嘴;a. 低劣的,不可靠的

examples.en: The costume includes a crisp white dickie under the jacket.
examples.zh: 这套戏装包括外套内笔挺的白色假前襟。

meaning: n. 系钩线;a. 厉害的, 精明的

examples.en: He tied a snell to the hook before casting off.
examples.zh: 抛竿前他给鱼钩绑了系钩线。

meaning: (英国)诺 森伯兰(Northumbria)的(人、方言), 诺森伯兰郡的(人、方言)

examples.en: He speaks with a soft Northumbrian accent and quiet humor.
examples.zh: 他带着诺森伯兰口音,说话温和风趣。

meaning: n. 迫击炮

examples.en: The patrol dove for cover when a minnie landed close by.
examples.zh: 迫击炮弹落在近旁,巡逻队赶紧卧倒。

meaning: n. 相同, 同样, 千篇一律

examples.en: The sameness of cafeteria food soon made him miss home cooking.
examples.zh: 食堂饭菜千篇一律,他很快就想念家里的味道。

meaning: n. 中央部分, 上腹部;正中切开

examples.en: Regular core work gradually strengthens your midsection.
examples.zh: 经常练核心能逐渐增强腰腹力量。

meaning: a. 感应的；诱发型

examples.en: The doctors induced labor a week after her due date.
examples.zh: 预产期一周后,医生为她引产。

meaning: n. 温床

examples.en: In the nineties the campus was a hotbed of new ideas.
examples.zh: 九十年代,这所校园是新鲜思想的温床。

meaning: n. 调解者, 和事佬

examples.en: The teacher acted as peacemaker in the playground quarrel.
examples.zh: 老师在操场争执中充当和事佬。

meaning: n. 名字, 绰号

examples.en: Fans gave the speedy striker the moniker of the Little Rocket.
examples.zh: 球迷给这位飞快的前锋起了小火箭的绰号。

meaning: 任天堂

examples.en: The boys played Nintendo all through the rainy Sunday afternoon.
examples.zh: 下雨的周日下午,男孩们一直玩任天堂。

meaning: a. 传奇剧风格的, 戏剧似的, 夸张的

examples.en: Her melodramatic sighs made the tiny delay seem enormous.
examples.zh: 她夸张的叹气把小小的延误搞得像天大的事。

meaning: n. 一种书桌, 两用沙发

examples.en: Grandpa naps on the davenport every afternoon after lunch.
examples.zh: 爷爷每天午饭后都在两用沙发上小睡。

meaning: n. 猥亵者；性骚扰者

examples.en: The court heard testimony against the accused molester yesterday.
examples.zh: 法院昨天听取了针对被告猥亵者的证词。

meaning: n. 编史, 历史之编纂

examples.en: The seminar examines the historiography of the French Revolution.
examples.zh: 研讨课研究法国大革命的史学编纂。

meaning: n. 疱疹;疱疹

examples.en: The doctor explained how the herpes virus causes cold sores.
examples.zh: 医生讲解了疱疹病毒如何引起唇疮。

meaning: a. 婚外的;私通的, 通奸的

examples.en: The scandal involved an extramarital affair with a junior colleague.
examples.zh: 丑闻涉及与一名下属的婚外情。

meaning: n. 榛实;榛实

examples.en: The bakery smells of chocolate and roasted hazelnut every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上,面包房里都是巧克力和烤榛子的香味。

meaning: n. 木兰, 浅桃红色;木兰属

examples.en: The magnolia by the gate blooms before the leaves appear.
examples.zh: 门口的玉兰先开花后长叶。

meaning: n. 婆罗洲

examples.en: Orangutans in Borneo face shrinking rainforests every year.
examples.zh: 婆罗洲的猩猩每年都面临雨林缩减。

meaning: v. (使)惊跑, (使)蜂拥;n. 惊跑, 蜂拥

examples.en: A clap of thunder triggered a stampede of cattle across the field.
examples.zh: 一声炸雷引发牛群狂奔过田野。

meaning: a. 沙皇的, 沙皇式的, 专制的, 沙皇时代的, 沙皇派的, 拥护沙皇制度的;n. 沙皇的支持者, 沙皇制度的支持者

examples.en: The novel is set in the twilight of tsarist Russia.
examples.zh: 小说以沙俄末期为背景。

meaning: n. 湖边

examples.en: We rented a small cabin by the lakeside for a week.
examples.zh: 我们在湖边租了间小木屋住一周。

meaning: n. 阿尔及尔

examples.en: The old casbah of Algiers looks down on the harbor.
examples.zh: 阿尔及尔的旧城堡区俯瞰着海港。

meaning: 分析器, 检偏振器

examples.en: The lab uses a gas analyser to monitor air quality.
examples.zh: 实验室用气体分析仪监测空气质量。

meaning: n. 洗脑;vt. 对人洗脑

examples.en: The sect tried to brainwash new members with endless lectures.
examples.zh: 该教派企图用无休止的灌输给新成员洗脑。

meaning: a. 沉思的, 冥想的

examples.en: She sat by the window, musing about her next novel.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗边,构思着下一部小说。

meaning: 展览会, 市集, 义卖

examples.en: The tech expo opens in the convention center on Monday.
examples.zh: 科技博览会周一在会展中心开幕。

meaning: n. 走入邪路, 败坏, 堕落, 违反常情, 变态, 反常, 误用, 滥用, 歪曲, 颠倒;倒错, 乖常, 颠倒

examples.en: Critics called the remake a perversion of the original film.
examples.zh: 评论家说这部翻拍片糟蹋了原作。

meaning: n. 边沁（英国哲学家）

examples.en: The course covers Bentham and the rise of utilitarian thought.
examples.zh: 课程讲边沁和功利主义思想的兴起。

meaning: a. 徒步的, 在进行中的, 活动中的;adv. 徒步, 在进行中

examples.en: There was something afoot in the sleepy village that winter.
examples.zh: 那年冬天,安静的小村里有些蹊跷。

meaning: n. 小母牛

examples.en: The young heifer kicked the gate open at feeding time.
examples.zh: 喂食时小母牛把门踢开了。

meaning: n. 西鲱

examples.en: Shad swim up the river to spawn every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天西鲱都会洄游到河里产卵。

meaning: n. 赞成票, 投赞成票者;adv. 永远

examples.en: The chairman counted each ay with a quick nod.
examples.zh: 主席一边点头一边数着赞成票。

meaning: n. 红脖子（指美国南方保守的露天劳动者）；乡下人

examples.en: He plays a friendly redneck mechanic in the new sitcom.
examples.zh: 他在新情景喜剧里演一个友善的乡下技工。

meaning: vt. 放弃, 在...之前, 居先

examples.en: He decided to forego dessert and order fresh fruit instead.
examples.zh: 他决定不吃甜点,改点新鲜水果。

meaning: 萨德伯里

examples.en: He grew up in Sudbury, far north of the big city.
examples.zh: 他在大城市以北很远的萨德伯里长大。

meaning: n. 塞内加尔

examples.en: Her family moved from Senegal to Paris when she was six.
examples.zh: 她六岁时全家从塞内加尔搬到巴黎。

meaning: a. 城市间的

examples.en: The intercity express reaches Bordeaux in just over two hours.
examples.zh: 城际快车两个多小时就能到波尔多。

meaning: n. 龙骑兵, 骑兵, 暴徒;vt. 以武力迫害, 弹压, 强制

examples.en: The dragoon polished his tall boots before the royal parade.
examples.zh: 阅兵前,龙骑兵把高筒靴擦得锃亮。

meaning: n. 天窗

examples.en: We spent an entire morning inside the Louvre.
examples.zh: 我们在卢浮宫里逛了一上午。

meaning: n. 眼罩, 障眼物;vt. 遮眼, 蒙骗

examples.en: The kids wore a blindfold for the donkey game.
examples.zh: 孩子们蒙着眼罩玩钉驴尾巴游戏。

meaning: vt. 迷住, 使迷恋

examples.en: She quickly became enamored with pottery during a short evening course.
examples.zh: 短短一期晚间课程就让她迷上了陶艺。

meaning: n. 评价者, 定价员;估价者

examples.en: The bank sent an independent valuer to inspect the house.
examples.zh: 银行派了一位独立估价师来验房。

meaning: 计算机辅助学习

examples.en: The school introduced a cal program for extra math practice.
examples.zh: 学校引入了计算机辅助学习项目来加强数学练习。

meaning: a. 装作爱好艺术的, 附庸风雅的

examples.en: The cafe's arty walls are covered in local students' paintings.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆附庸风雅的墙上挂满了本地学生的画。

meaning: n. 监狱, 收容所, 教养所, 宗教裁判所;a. 用作感化的, 应处监禁的, 教养所的, 收容所的

examples.en: He worked as a guard at the state penitentiary for years.
examples.zh: 他在州监狱当了多年狱警。

meaning: n. 投手, (家具的)脚轮, 调味瓶;后倾角

examples.en: Replace the broken caster under the wobbly office chair.
examples.zh: 把摇晃办公椅下坏的脚轮换掉。

meaning: a. 易记住的, 欺骗性的, 不规则发生的

examples.en: The band's new single has a very catchy chorus.
examples.zh: 乐队新单曲的副歌特别洗脑。

meaning: a. (陶瓷)罗森塔尔制造的

examples.en: The holiday table was set with delicate Rosenthal porcelain.
examples.zh: 节日的餐桌上摆着精致的罗森塔尔瓷器。

meaning: n. 板条, 木板;夹板, 撑条

examples.en: Sailors fix a wooden batten across the hatch in storms.
examples.zh: 遇风暴时水手会在舱口横固一根木条。

meaning: n. 柚木;柚木

examples.en: The balcony furniture is made of weather-resistant teak.
examples.zh: 阳台家具是耐候的柚木做的。

meaning: a. 无计划的, 未经筹划的, 意外的, 在计划外的

examples.en: An unplanned stop in Vienna became the trip's best memory.
examples.zh: 维也纳的临时停留成了此行最美好的回忆。

meaning: n. 青稞酒（等于chong）

examples.en: He tasted chang, a traditional barley brew, in the mountain village.
examples.zh: 他在山村尝了尝青稞酒这种传统饮品。

meaning: n. 阿肯色州

examples.en: Her family runs a small chicken farm in Arkansas.
examples.zh: 她家在阿肯色州经营一个小养鸡场。

meaning: n. 过去的事, 往事;a. 过去的

examples.en: The little shop sells lockets and clocks from a bygone era.
examples.zh: 小店卖旧时代的吊坠盒和老座钟。

meaning: n. 利文斯顿（美国新泽西州东北部城镇）

examples.en: She opened a small bakery in Livingston last spring.
examples.zh: 她去年春天在利文斯顿开了家小面包店。

meaning: vt. 再分配, 再指定;转交, 转让

examples.en: The manager decided to reassign Tom to the night shift.
examples.zh: 经理决定把汤姆调到夜班。

meaning: a. 纵容的, 任性的, 宽容的

examples.en: The indulgent grandmother let the kids skip their vegetables.
examples.zh: 宠孩子的奶奶由着他们不吃蔬菜。

meaning: n. 喀麦隆

examples.en: Cameroon's national team reached the quarterfinals that year.
examples.zh: 喀麦隆队那年打进了四分之一决赛。

meaning: n. (录音)重放, (录音)重放装置;重现

examples.en: Press this button to start playback of the recorded lecture.
examples.zh: 按这个键开始回放录制的讲座。

meaning: a. 未煮过的

examples.en: Store the uncooked rice in a cool, dry jar.
examples.zh: 把生米存放在阴凉干燥的罐子里。

meaning: n. 意大利乳清干酪

examples.en: The pasta shells are filled with spinach and creamy ricotta.
examples.zh: 意面壳里塞满了菠菜和乳清干酪。

meaning: n. 森林, 森林志

examples.en: The botanist wrote a silva describing every tree of the region.
examples.zh: 植物学家写了一部描述当地所有树木的树木志。

meaning: n. 枪鱼

examples.en: He fought the mighty marlin for hours off the coast.
examples.zh: 他在近海与大马林鱼搏斗了几个小时。

meaning: n. 洪都拉斯

examples.en: This coffee comes from a small farm in Honduras.
examples.zh: 这批咖啡产自洪都拉斯的一个小农场。

meaning: vt. 打开

examples.en: The children could hardly wait to unwrap their birthday presents.
examples.zh: 孩子们迫不及待地想拆生日礼物。

meaning: n. 定殖；殖民地化；集群现象

examples.en: The island's colonisation began soon after the first mapmakers arrived.
examples.zh: 最初的测绘者到来后不久,该岛就开始了殖民化。

meaning: 尼维斯岛

examples.en: They sailed across to Nevis for a quiet weekend.
examples.zh: 他们坐船去尼维斯岛度了个安静的周末。

meaning: a. 逗引性的, 干着急的

examples.en: A tantalizing smell of fresh bread drifted from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房里飘来诱人的新鲜面包香。

meaning: n. 输送人, 运输机;运输船; 运输机

examples.en: The huge transporter carried two race cars to the circuit.
examples.zh: 大型运输车把两辆赛车运到了赛道。

meaning: a. 醉酒的

examples.en: The dishes were carefully boxed before the movers arrived.
examples.zh: 搬家工人来之前,餐具都仔细装了箱。

meaning: abbr. 天文学高级研究中心（Centre for Advanced Study of Astronomy）；计算机与自动化系统（Computer and A

examples.en: Her research team at CASA studies distant galaxies.
examples.zh: 她在天文学高级研究中心的团队研究遥远星系。

meaning: vi. 返回, 退走, 撤退, 放弃;回溯

examples.en: The mayor had to backtrack after protesters filled the square.
examples.zh: 抗议者挤满广场后,市长不得不改口。

meaning: a. <正>排斥（性）的, 排除在外的

examples.en: The club finally dropped its exclusionary membership rules.
examples.zh: 俱乐部最终取消了排他性的会员规定。

meaning: n. 亚丁(也门城市)

examples.en: The old port of Aden was busy with fishing boats.
examples.zh: 亚丁老港里渔船往来穿梭。

meaning: adv. 在外交上, 靠外交途径, 凭外交手腕

examples.en: She diplomatically suggested postponing the meeting until Monday.
examples.zh: 她婉转地建议把会议推迟到周一。

meaning: a. 喧闹的, 大声的, 好色的;n. 粗鲁悍妇, 莽汉

examples.en: Randy offered to carry the heavy boxes upstairs.
examples.zh: 兰迪主动帮忙把重箱子搬上楼。

meaning: n. 锁骨;锁骨

examples.en: He broke his collarbone falling off the scooter.
examples.zh: 他从滑板车上摔下来,锁骨骨折了。

meaning: n. 印加；印加人

examples.en: Machu Picchu is the most famous Inca site in the Andes.
examples.zh: 马丘比丘是安第斯山最著名的印加遗址。

meaning: vt. 使理想化;vi. 理想化, 形成思想, 描述理想

examples.en: Movies often idealize small-town life in a charming way.
examples.zh: 电影常把小镇生活浪漫化得迷人。

meaning: n. 尖头, 尖端;尖

examples.zh: 公司正处在重大突破的关口。

meaning: n. 罐头制造;装罐头

examples.en: Grandma spends every autumn canning tomatoes from her garden.
examples.zh: 奶奶每年秋天都把园里的番茄做成罐头。

meaning: n. 弗朗西斯卡（女名）

examples.en: Francesca baked almond cookies for the school bake sale.
examples.zh: 弗朗西斯卡为学校义卖烤了杏仁饼干。

meaning: n. 土木工事, 土方工程

examples.en: The ancient earthwork still curves across the hilltop field.
examples.zh: 古代的土木工事仍蜿蜒在山顶田地上。

meaning: n. 呈锯齿状, 缩排, 缺口, 印凹痕;缩进

examples.en: Check the indentation of every paragraph before you submit.
examples.zh: 提交前检查每段的缩进。

meaning: n. 奥菲士(希腊神话人物)

examples.en: In the myth, Orpheus charms every living thing with music.
examples.zh: 神话中,俄耳甫斯的音乐让万物沉醉。

meaning: n. 诈骗, 敲诈勒索

examples.en: The mob boss was finally convicted of racketeering.
examples.zh: 黑帮老大最终被判敲诈勒索罪。

meaning: n. 比阿特丽克斯(Beatrice的异体)(f.)

examples.en: The children still love the rabbit tales by Beatrix.
examples.zh: 孩子们仍然喜爱比阿特丽克斯写的兔子故事。

meaning: n. 政治化

examples.en: The senator complained about the politicization of the weather service.
examples.zh: 参议员抱怨气象部门被政治化。

meaning: n. 哥萨克, 武装镇压队队员, 哥萨克轻骑兵, 哥萨克人;a. 哥萨克的, 哥萨克人的

examples.en: A cossack on horseback guarded the bridge at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时一名哥萨克骑兵守在桥头。

meaning: a. 无表情的, 呆板的

examples.en: The guard stayed expressionless as we showed our passes.
examples.zh: 我们出示通行证时,卫兵始终面无表情。

meaning: n. 醋酸盐;醋酸盐(或酯、根)

examples.en: The old recordings were transferred from fragile acetate discs.
examples.zh: 老录音从易碎的醋酸唱片上转录下来。

meaning: vt. 给原纱染色, 使根深蒂固;a. 原纱染色的, 根深蒂固的

examples.en: Good coaches ingrain basic habits in their youngest players.
examples.zh: 好教练让小球员把基本功刻进骨子里。

meaning: n. 售货员

examples.en: A patient salesperson helped us choose a suitable laptop.
examples.zh: 一位耐心的售货员帮我们挑了合适的笔记本电脑。

meaning: n. 康德（德国哲学家）

examples.en: Kant argued that all knowledge begins with experience.
examples.zh: 康德认为一切知识都始于经验。

meaning: n. 雨暴

examples.en: A sudden rainstorm soaked everyone at the school picnic.
examples.zh: 一场骤雨把学校野餐的人都淋透了。

meaning: n. 博茨瓦纳（非洲中南部国家）

examples.en: Botswana is home to some of Africa's largest elephant herds.
examples.zh: 博茨瓦纳栖息着非洲最大的一些象群。

meaning: a. 以金属丝加强的, 接有电线的, 以铁丝围起的

examples.en: The new apartment is wired for fast internet throughout.
examples.zh: 新公寓全屋都布好了高速网络线。

meaning: a. 嵌入的, 镶嵌的, 镶饰的;inlay的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The cabinet doors are inlaid with pale mother of pearl.
examples.zh: 柜门上镶嵌着浅色的珍珠母。

meaning: n. 宙斯

examples.en: Zeus rules the gods from high Mount Olympus.
examples.zh: 宙斯在奥林匹斯山上统领众神。

meaning: a. 有鉴赏力的, 趣味高雅的, 雅观的

examples.en: She decorated the narrow hallway in a simple, tasteful style.
examples.zh: 她把窄走廊装修得简洁雅致。

meaning: n. (神经)突触, 神经键;突触, 神经键
